**About Us** 
Ten Five Hospitality is a growing collective of restaurants, bars, and entertainment venues known for concept-driven experiences and standout hospitality. Headquartered between Los Angeles and Miami, Ten Five holds a history of working with and crafting some of the most sought after brands in the world. Ten Five represents the organizational, operational and creative excellence to bring original and authentic visions to life while outperforming the market on the bottom-line.

**Position Summary**

The Director of Operations – Restaurants is responsible for overseeing effective operating procedures within the restaurant while developing a successful management team.

**Daily Responsibilities**

* Plan and direct administration and planning functions of the Food & Beverage department to meet the daily needs of the operation.
* Clearly describe, assign, and delegate responsibility and authority for the operation of the various food & beverage positions.
* Possesses knowledge of all front-of-house job duties.
* Provides financial oversight and prepares and presents financial and operations reports.
* Possesses in-depth knowledge of all operational systems in use including but not limited to payroll, inventory and purchasing.
* Ensures that all mechanical systems are in good working order and compliant with all federal, state and local ordinances.
* Regulates all executive-level POS functions.
* Oversee and supervise the execution of front-of-house operations to ensure quality, safety, efficiency, and profitability.
* Assists managers in establishing and achieving predetermined profit objectives and desired standards of quality of food, service, cleanliness and promotion.
* Responsible, with the Executive Chef and General Manager, for maintaining the venue’s monthly Profit & Loss statement standards while meeting or exceeding budget expectations through controlling P&L items.
* Oversees that training programs are in place for employees to update their knowledge on relevant industry practices.
* Oversees that the venue is compliant with all federal, state, and local laws and regulations and company policies.
* Possesses in-depth knowledge of all food and beverage menus.
* Oversees that all guest and employee concerns are resolved in a way that promotes guest retention.
* Oversees the replacement or repair of all breakage or damage of equipment, furniture, or other company property.
* Ensures front-of-house employees follow all policies and procedures by providing clear guidelines and expectations.
* Maintain professional appearance standards as directed in the Employee Handbook.
* Anticipates and accommodates needs of guests while providing professional and exceptional service to ensure guest satisfaction.
* Protects establishment, guests, and employees by adhering to and overseeing that the Department of Health and company sanitation standards are followed.
* Responsible for management interviewing, hiring, and training process decisions.
* Coaches front-of-house managers as needed and assists in their professional development.

**Physical Requirements**

* Must be able to stand, walk, lift, and bend for extended periods of time.
* Must be able to bend and lift up to 50 lbs.
* Role may include job duties or tasks requiring repetitive motions.
* Exposure to hot kitchen elements or cleaning materials.

**Skills/Experience**

* Minimum five (5) years’ experience working in a general management role in hospitality/nightlife/ bars.
* Passionate about hospitality, food and beverage and morale/culture.
* Ability to think proactively and creatively, have decision making and analytical skills and be effective in written and verbal communication.
* Self-motivated with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, effectively multi-task, and drive results.
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
* Ability to work a flexible schedule including evenings, weekends, and holidays when required.

**About LawnStarter**

LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, spanning three brands: LawnStarter, Lawn Love, and Home Gnome. We've cleared $750M in bookings and turned a profit three years running. Founded in Austin in 2013, we're a team of about 180 that scales past 500 employees during peak season. The marketplace itself is easy to describe and hard to run well: a customer requests a service, we price the job and match it to an eligible Pro, the Pro claims and completes the work, and we process payment and take a commission.

We're entering the most ambitious stretch in the company's history as we build new verticals, new software products, and the groundwork to become a multi-billion-dollar company.

One of our company values is AI or Extinction: every task, AI-first. No exceptions, no excuses. Top 1% or we're already a fossil. This role is hired against that bar.

**The Role**

This is a biz ops generalist role, built for someone who wants to work across many parts of the business instead of owning one narrow lane. You'll start as an individual contributor with no direct reports, in a new seat reporting directly to the COO. Your first owned area will be building Service Delivery into a working operational function. This will entail adding structure, visibility and process to the way we ensure as many customer jobs as possible are completed successfully and on time by LawnStarter Pros, in lawn care and other services we offer now and over time.

New projects will show up unscoped over time. That's by design. As LawnStarter enters new verticals and grows toward a multi-billion-dollar future, big problems will keep surfacing with no obvious owner, and you'll be one of the people the COO trusts to run them down.

**What makes this role different:**

* You work on some of the biggest company-wide projects, cutting across teams and functional areas.
* You'll be a top builder in Brain, LawnStarter's internal AI toolkit built on Claude Code that already powers everything we do across the company: metric queries, document drafting, bug triage, and more. We expect you to approach your work in an AI-first fashion, leveraging Brain to build new systems and processes that will push the limits of how fast AI can accelerate business results. Every project you run is built AI-first: the analysis, the tooling, the process automation, the monitoring. You build it yourself instead of waiting on an analyst or engineer.
* You own outcomes end to end, from recommendation through execution. Strategy without follow-through doesn't count here.

**What You'll Own**

* **Service Delivery, from the ground up.** Despite LawnStarter's considerable scale and reach, Service Delivery doesn't exist yet as a dedicated function. You'll help define the standards we should meet for job completion rates and speed, measure whether we hit them, and design processes, incentives and real-time interventions that get tested with Pros and customers in the field to lift performance. Scope covers every vertical and every delivery model, from today's 1099 Pros to potential W-2 crews under future evaluation.
* **Raising customer & Pro retention rates.** When we deliver service with excellence, Pros and customers alike stay with us longer. Working tightly with peers across Product, Data and Support, you'll identify new opportunities for us to boost retention and LTV and play a key role in driving resulting initiatives cross-functionally.

**Job Description:** 
Responsible for the management of all aspects of a sand mining and production facility. This position will utilize budgets, production goals, and effective communication. Safety must be a top priority. 
 
**Job Requirements:** 
**ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** 
 
Direct the following department personnel to ensure safety and productivity is achieved. 
1. Mine Team 
2. Wash Operators 
3. Dry Plant Operators 
4. Quality/Lab 
5. Maintenance

* Efficiently schedule and supervise hourly personnel for weekly operations, monitor timecards, vacations, and control overtime.
* Work with corporate HR department on staffing needs and employee issues.
* Handle discipline and grievances, as required, while maintaining acceptable labor and employee relations.
* Accurately collect, review, and forward operating data, such as mine, wash, and dry plant production reports.
* Assist HSE Coordinator in collecting the necessary data for MSHA and DNR reports.
* Communicate effectively and timely with owners, corporate directors, and/or other management of problems or potential problems that affect the proper operation of the plant. Problems may include personnel, equipment, transportation, quality, or raw materials.
* Direct activities safely to achieve optimum rates of productivity consistent with long/short range goals
* Direct and coordinate plant/mine related projects with Director of Mining
* Assisting in the preparation of capital projects and plan, and their completion • Direct and oversee activities performed by subcontractors.
* Monitor the mine operation to ensure compliance with all regulations concerning air emissions, water discharge, erosion and sedimentation control.
* Assist, implement, and comply with ISO 9001 quality program.
* Review quality reports daily and ensure quality standards are being followed.
* Evaluate with the EHS Coordinator the company’s training program and conditions in the plant, creating a culture of safety that exceeds MSHA guidelines and regulations.
* Ensure safety and good housekeeping by being active in all programs.
* Recommend and/or purchase materials and supplies as necessary, utilizing corporate purchasing department. Recommend equipment and process modifications to improve efficiencies.
* Ensure work standards, policies, plans, and procedures are enforced. Support management’s policies and programs.

**ADDITIONAL REQUIRMENTS**

* Team-oriented, an effective communicator (verbal and written), able to offer technical expertise and guidance, and have the ability and willingness to build rapport with department team members and external departments.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and set priorities appropriately.
* Understanding our company functions as a cohesive operation, and often employees serve in many roles and various functions or capacities.
* Develop working relationships with other corporate personnel and plants.
* Maintain open communications with subordinates, peers, and superiors.
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Excel

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s Degree, in Business Management or related field
* 3 to 5 years of related experience in a position of leadership, Surface Mining Experience preferred
* Valid driver’s license required.
* Advanced experience working with MSHA Safety and Environmental competency
* Supervisory skills
* Budgetary skills - Capital planning and projects
* Short and long-term planning and scheduling
* Leadership Skills

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Pass toxicity test.
* Medical clearance to wear respiratory protection.
* Team?oriented, effective communicator (verbal and written), able to offer technical expertise and guidance, and
* have the ability and willingness to build rapport with team members and external agencies.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and set priorities appropriately.
* Willingness to further training or education, if requested.

record.ROLE_TEXT:
**VP of Production**
--------------------

**Location:** Los Angeles, Detroit, or San Francisco 
**Employment:** Full time, in person 
**Base salary:** $200,000–$350,000 annually

American factories deserve a supply chain that moves as fast as they do. Nox Metals is building it, along with the tools that run it. We’re a technology company supplying raw metal to frontier American manufacturers. We use software and automation to supply metal to factories faster than the industry thought possible.

### **The role**

We’re hiring a VP of Production to lead manufacturing performance across Nox Metals’ facilities. You will own how work moves through our factories: production planning, daily execution, capacity, staffing, quality, productivity, and on-time delivery.

This is a hands-on manufacturing leadership role with real time on the factory floor. You will develop production leaders, resolve constraints, and create repeatable ways of working that help teams deliver as demand grows. Success means safe, reliable production and clear accountability from the daily schedule through completed customer orders.

### **You will**

* Lead production execution across facilities, with clear expectations for safety, quality, output, cost, and delivery.
* Translate demand into practical production, staffing, shift, and capacity plans.
* Develop plant and production leaders who take ownership of results and build strong teams.
* Establish daily operating reviews, shift handoffs, escalation paths, and performance measures that drive action.
* Identify bottlenecks, reduce downtime and rework, and improve material flow and labor productivity.
* Build consistent training, work instructions, and qualification standards while staying close to how work happens.
* Protect material traceability and quality throughout production.
* Partner with maintenance and engineering on equipment reliability, capacity improvements, and automation.
* Work with supply chain and commercial teams to align material availability, production commitments, and customer needs.
* Partner with finance on production economics and equipment investment decisions.
* Help new or expanded facilities establish reliable production and sustain performance as they ramp.

### **You are**

* A manufacturing leader with a record of improving factory performance and developing accountable leaders.
* Experienced managing production teams, schedules, equipment constraints, and competing priorities.
* Uncompromising about safety, quality, and traceability.
* Fluent in capacity, throughput, labor productivity, downtime, and delivery performance.
* Comfortable making decisions on the floor and following through until problems are resolved.
* Practical, direct, and interested in improving manufacturing with software and automation.

### **Nice to have**

Experience leading multiple facilities, scaling production through rapid growth, or working in metals, machining, aerospace, industrial distribution, or related environments.

Expect regular time at our manufacturing facilities and travel between sites as needed.

Nox Metals is an equal opportunity employer. We hire based on skill, attitude, and fit for the work, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, height, weight, marital status, or any other protected status under federal, state, or local law.

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, and the California Fair Chance Act.

Compensation Range: $200K - $350K

The Senior Manager of Quality is responsible for establishing and leading all quality activities for a complex aerospace development program from prototype through production readiness. This role serves as the primary quality leader embedded within the program team and partners closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Flight Test, and Program Management to ensure products are designed, developed, tested, and transitioned to production with quality, reliability, and mission success as foundational objectives.

The Senior Manager of Quality will build and lead a multidisciplinary quality team while implementing scalable quality systems, risk management processes, problem-solving disciplines, and development quality practices appropriate for a rapidly growing aerospace and defense technology organization.

Gwynedd Manufacturing is seeking a hands-on Senior Manager of Production with a strong CNC machining background to lead day-to-day operations in a high-precision environment. This role is ideal for someone who has progressed through the ranks—from the shop floor into leadership—and is ready to step into a broader operational role.

The ideal candidate brings deep, practical knowledge of CNC machining (mills, lathes, EDM) and thrives in a fast-paced, high-tolerance manufacturing setting. This is not a purely strategic role—this leader will be actively engaged on the floor, driving performance, mentoring teams, and continuously improving processes.

Key Responsibilities:

* Lead daily plant operations with a strong presence on the manufacturing floor, ensuring output, quality, and efficiency targets are met
* Direct oversight of machining operations including CNC mills, lathes, and EDM, ensuring optimal machine utilization and performance
* Manage and develop a team of supervisors, leads, and machinists (50–100+ employees)
* Serve as a technical resource and mentor, supporting setup, programming, and troubleshooting when needed
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on cycle time reduction, scrap reduction, and process standardization
* Partner closely with Engineering and Quality to ensure tight tolerance requirements and manufacturability of parts
* Own production scheduling, workflow optimization, and labor planning to meet customer demand
* Establish and reinforce shop floor accountability, KPIs, and standard work practices
* Maintain a safe, compliant, and disciplined manufacturing environment
* Support new product introductions and prototype builds with a strong understanding of machining constraints
* Overseeing multiple departments withing the manufacturing space.

Qualifications:

* 5+ years of progressive manufacturing experience, with clear growth from hands-on machining into leadership
* Strong CNC background required (setup, programming, and/or machining experience with mills, lathes, EDM)
* Prior experience in roles such as Machine Shop Manager, Manufacturing Manager, or Plant Manager
* Proven ability to lead teams in a high-precision, tight-tolerance environment
* Deep understanding of machining processes, tooling, fixturing, and production workflows
* Experience driving continuous improvement on the shop floor (Lean, process optimization, etc.)
* Comfortable being hands-on and highly visible in daily operations, not just managing from an office
* Strong leadership and communication skills with the ability to develop talent from within
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related field preferred, but equivalent hands-on experience strongly valued

Physical and Work Environment Requirements: 
This position is based in a manufacturing environment and may require the following over extended periods of time up to a full 8-hour work shift (excluding lunch and breaks): stand, walk, sit, squat or bend, kneel and rise, lift, carry, push, or pull materials and equipment weighing up to — and occasionally exceeding — 50 pounds, view a computer or other digital screen, work on a computer, workstation or comparable system, and make accurate entries in such systems. Manual dexterity and fine motor skills are required for detailed assembly and precision work. Work may take place in areas with varying temperatures or no climate control, varying noise levels, and production equipment in motion. Proper personal protective equipment (PPE) must be worn in designated areas at all times as required by company policy. Reasonable accommodations may be available to enable individuals with disabilities but are always subject to safety concerns for the employee and all team members. Employer may require a physical assessment of the candidate’s ability to perform these tasks as a condition of an offer letter. Any assessment will be performed by a third party vendor and will be reported on a pass/fail basis with no other medical

Capitol Aggregates, a division of Zachry, stands on a rich tradition of creativity, stability, innovation, and experience in the construction and building materials industry. Fully understanding that Capitols employees are the heart of our success, we foster a dynamic work environment by providing development opportunities such as training, education, and career advancement.

We believe people are our greatest asset and offer a variety of training and development opportunities to promote excellence and facilitate career advancement. We take care of our team members as family, within a culture of service where we do the right thing because it is the right thing to do.

**Our Core Values guide everything we do:**

Every Person Matters | Together We Can Do Great Things | This Is More Than a Job

The Plant Manager is responsible for overseeing the overall production, safety, maintenance, and employee management activities at the aggregate operations site. This role ensures operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and a strong culture of safety and environmental stewardship. The Plant Manager leads all aspects of site performance with a hands-on, collaborative approach, ensuring operational goals are met while building a high-performing team and delivering strong customer service.

**What Youll Do**

* Lead, plan, and direct daily plant operations including production, maintenance, and material handling.
* Manage production schedules, inventory controls, and key cost drivers to meet operational and financial targets.
* Lead employee life cycle activities including hiring, training, coaching, and performance management.
* Establish and enforce a strong safety culture ensuring compliance with MSHA, OSHA, environmental, and company standards.
* Monitor plant performance, operating costs, and efficiency to drive continuous improvement.
* Provide regular performance updates and strategic input to the Area Manager.

* Strong operational knowledge of aggregate production and equipment maintenance.
* Working knowledge of MSHA, OSHA, and environmental regulations.
* Proven ability to lead teams, set priorities, and deliver results.
* Strong problem-solving, organizational, and decision-making skills.
* Demonstrated commitment to safety leadership and operational excellence.

* High School Diploma or GED required.
* Associate degree in Leadership, Supervision, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* 1015 years of progressive experience in aggregates, mining, or heavy industrial operations required.
* 510 years of experience leading and managing teams in a plant or operations setting required.
* 35 years of direct maintenance experience within a plant environment required.
* Familiarity with the operation of mobile heavy equipment preferred.

**Other Qualifications**

* Consistent enforcement of safe work practices and PPE usage.
* Ability to interpret safety regulations, equipment manuals, and operational standards.
* Adaptability to changing operational demands and a collaborative, team-oriented approach.

**Leadership Expectations**

* Communicate the companys vision and values clearly to employees.
* Lead with integrity, professionalism, and sound judgment.
* Inspire a culture of safety, accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
* Serve as a mentor and role model within the plant.

Capitol Aggregates offers an industry leading benefits package for our employees and their families.

* Medical, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance
* 401K, Paid Leave and Bonus Program

The **Director, Field Service Operations - Southeast Region** will lead and execute the strategic and operational direction of the L/M/HV Services business across a regional footprint, with clear ownership for safety performance, quality execution, financial delivery, and disciplined project management. This leader will be responsible for P&L performance, team leadership, and customer satisfaction across aftermarket services, lifecycle programs, and project execution within the region. The role is central to driving business growth, strengthening operational controls, developing talent, and ensuring field work is planned, executed, and closed out with strong safety, quality, cost, and schedule discipline.

 

This is a **hybrid position** based out of one of our Field Service corporate offices within the **Southeast Region**. The role requires **approximately 40% travel** throughout the assigned region to support business operations, customer relationships, field service teams, and business development initiatives.

 

**Strategic & Financial Leadership**

* Define and execute the service strategy for M/HV products in alignment with regional and corporate objectives.
* Develop and lead growth plans for aftermarket services, engineering solutions, and lifecycle contracts.
* Expand and evolve service offerings (e.g., retrofits, upgrades, and maintenance agreements).
* Ownership of the service P&L for the M/HV segment, including revenue, margin, cost controls, and EBITDA for the defined area.
* Work collaboratively with the President to focus on pricing strategy, cost management, margin optimization, and budget planning for the Southeast region.

 

**Operational Excellence**

* Oversee delivery of safe, high-quality services across all active projects and accounts, while delighting the customer.
* Leverage operational tools (Salesforce, Power BI, etc.) to track KPIs and drive data-informed decisions.
* Ensure efficient use of internal labor and subcontractors, oversee backlog management, inventory, receivables, and timely project execution.
* Drive standardization, continuous improvement, and best practice across field operations.

* Champion a culture focused on safety, quality, accountability, and excellence in customer service delivery through our core values.
* Develop and mentor leadership and technical talent, with a focus on building a NETA certified workforce.
* Ensure all work is performed in accordance with health and safety requirements and in compliance with state and federal regulations.
* Partner with HR and Talent Acquisition on workforce planning, hiring strategies, and technical development programs.

 

**Customer & Commercial Engagement**

* Support President on strategic customer accounts; manage escalations and ensure satisfaction.
* Drive alignment between operations and sales to deliver on service bookings, upsell/cross-sell opportunities, and long-term agreements.
* Actively support the development of complex bids, proposals, and emergency response strategies.
* Participate in customer site visits and strategic planning meetings for projects.

* Strong financial acumen and demonstrated experience managing a full P&L, including budgeting, forecasting, pricing, margin improvement, cost control, and working capital performance.
* Proven leadership of multi-site service operations and technical field teams.
* Strong understanding of M/HV systems, NETA testing requirements, and utility/industrial service environments.
* Experience with Salesforce, project management tools, and business analytics platforms.

**Job Details:**

Summary: This position is responsible for supporting overall plant operations and performance, including controlling expenses, ensuring compliance with federal meat inspection, OSHA, food safety, and company requirements, and consistently interpreting and enforcing company policies. The position partners with HR and plant leadership to support effective Team Member and labor relations in a union environment, including adherence to the collective bargaining agreement. Responsibilities include assisting in determining staffing needs; maintaining accurate records and reports; effectively resolving operational issues with appropriate follow-up; and partnering with department leaders to achieve production, quality, yield, labor, cost, and performance goals. The position is also responsible for maintaining high standards in safety, sanitation, housekeeping, security, and food safety; leading, developing, evaluating, and coaching production leaders; overseeing designated shift operations; and performing other responsibilities as assigned by the Plant Manager.

 

REQUIREMENTS:

 

Education:

High School diploma with equivalent experience or college degree preferred.

 

Experience:

5 plus years of related industry; 5 plus years supervisory experience in a meat processing facility pork or beef preferred ; and knowledge of OSHA USDA and HAACP regulations.

 

Computer Skills:

Standard computer skills.

 

Communication Skills:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Must be capable of communicating well both verbally and in writing with all levels of Team Members from hourly to upper management as well as government officials.

 

Special Skills:

Leader problem solver team player.

 

Supervisory Responsibilities:

Manage subordinate General Foreman supervisors who supervise team members in the plant; carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organizations policies and applicable laws; interview hire and train team members; plan assign and direct work; monitor and appraise work performance; reward, coach, counsel, and discipline team members; address complaints and resolve problems.

 

Travel:

0-20

 

Other Requirements:

Lead people by example, accept and delegate responsibility, display sound judgment and decision-making skills; problem solve in an efficient manner with sound follow up; strong managerial skills necessary; excellent safety and attendance records. Ability to work with department leaders to meet safety production and quality yields and meet goals. All Tyson Team Members are responsible for safety. This includes but is not limited to personal safety and food safety. This position is responsible for food safety food quality and legality.

 
 

Must attach a resume for consideration.

 
 

This position is slated for candidates who are currently working at this facility and displaced team members. Priority consideration will be provided to these applicants first. If local Team Members are not selected, external candidates will then be reviewed for consideration.

No

Livingston Associates has partnered with an established company, made up of highly skilled, capable individuals who are looking to add a Director of Operations to their growing team! 
 
**Position Summary:** 
The Director of Operations is responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operations for a specialty contractor with multiple offices in NYS, ensuring projects are executed safely, efficiently, and profitably. This role partners closely with the CEO/Owner to translate strategic goals into executable plans across field operations, labor, scheduling, safety, compliance, and internal processes.. This position should be filled with a proven hands-on leader who can operate independently, make sound business decisions, manage multiple operational priorities, and contribute strategically to the company's overall success. 
 
**Compensation:**

* **$**130,000-$160,000 per year

 
**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Operations & Field Execution**:
 + Oversee daily operations across all projects, ensuring schedules, budgets, and quality standards are met
 + Coordinate closely with Field Operations, Safety & Compliance and project managers to support successful project delivery
 + Resolve operational issues impacting productivity, customer satisfaction, or safety
 + Ensure materials, labor, equipment are properly aligned with project needs
* **Financial & Performance Management**
 + Support job cost controls, labor efficiency, and margin performance
 + Monitor KPIs related to productivity, safety, schedule adherence, and profitability
 + Collaborate with accounting and project teams on forecasting, labor planning, and cash flow management
* **Labor & Workforce Management**
 + Partner with field operations for workforce planning, labor projections, and staffing levels
 + Support hiring, onboarding, training, and development of field and operations staff
 + Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, and high performance
* **Safety, Compliance & Risk Management**
 + Partner with safety & compliance team to ensure compliance with OSHA, regulatory requirements, and company safety programs
 + Promote a strong safety-first culture across all field and office operations
 + Identify and mitigate operational and contractual risks
* **Process Improvement & Systems**
 + Develop, implement, and refine operational processes to improve efficiency and scalability
 + Lead adoption of tools, technology, and systems that streamline operations and reporting
 + Standardize best practices across projects and teams
* **Leadership & Strategy**
 + Partner with the CEO on strategic planning, growth initiatives, and operational alignment
 + Provide leadership, mentorship, and direction to operations team members
 + Support customer relationships and assist with issue resolution as needed

 
**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field preferred. Equivalent industry experience will be considered.
* Minimum of 10–15 years of progressive experience in commercial construction or specialty contracting.
* Minimum of 5–7 years in a senior operational leadership position with direct responsibility for project execution, personnel management, and financial performance.
* Demonstrated success managing operations for a construction company or division generating $20M–$40M+ in annual revenue.
* Experience overseeing multiple project teams and simultaneous projects across various geographic markets.

 
**Benefits & Incentives:**

* Paid time off
* Sick time
* 6 paid company holidays
* Health, Dental & Vision plan options
* Car allowance
* Fuel card
* 401(k) plan
* Professional development
* Short- & Long-term disability
* Life insurance
* Company/Team events
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Some people manage teams. Others build environments where elite technical talent thrives, innovation accelerates, and customers become lifelong advocates. We’re looking for a Digital Plant Manager who can do all three.

This isn’t a “keep the trains running” management role. We need a leader who can build and steward high-performing Agile teams, drive operational excellence, own financial outcomes, and help shape the future of Vertech’s Digital Plant organization. You’ll lead self-organizing Scrum teams delivering world class industrial automation and software solutions while guiding strategic investments in internal development tools and accelerators that improve how we work and scale.

If you know how to balance leadership with accountability, coaching with execution, and strategy with action—and you genuinely enjoy helping talented people do the best work of their careers—we should probably talk.

**Who We Are**

At Vertech, not only do we develop world class industrial automation solutions for some of the top US companies, we also strive to be the team of choice for the best and brightest talent. I mean, we call ourselves control freaks for a reason.

The passion (and intelligence) our employees have is truly mind-blowing. In turn, we work hard to take care of our own with excellent benefits and pay, personal development, and transparent communication. We also know that you can be great at what you do and still have fun.

If that sounds like a good fit, help us bring the next generation of automation solutions to industries including data centers, renewable energy, manufacturing, food and beverage, water and wastewater, and more.

**Top Reasons to Work with Us**

* Flexible work schedule with work from home options for many roles
* Weekly communication from management in our internally famous Friday morning meeting
* Competitive compensation including a bonus plan
* No more than a 4 week waiting period on all benefits including the 401k
* A really rad Christmas Party each year
* A manager that is cool…most of the time, because no one is perfect
* A path for growth, a great culture, PTO, AND MORE!

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Build, lead, and develop high-performing Professional Scrum teams capable of delivering world class customer outcomes
* Coach, mentor, and support team members through consistent feedback, career development, and leadership
* Ensure teams are staffed with the right people in the right roles while fostering Vertech’s culture and core values
* Own the financial performance and delivery outcomes of projects executed by your teams
* Serve as the primary escalation point for customers beyond the execution team
* Drive operational excellence using Professional Agile Leadership (PAL-E), Scrum principles, and Evidence Based Management (EBM)
* Govern and prioritize Digital Plant’s portfolio of internal software accelerators and development tools
* Partner with leadership to contribute to strategic planning and organizational growth initiatives
* Ensure investment initiatives are properly staffed, organized, funded, and aligned with company objectives
* Promote continuous improvement in delivery execution, technical excellence, and team collaboration
* Work closely with HR and leadership on hiring, onboarding, employee growth, and team performance
* Help create an environment where highly technical people genuinely enjoy coming to work

**What You Need for this Position**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related technical field (or equivalent industry experience)
* Deep expertise in Agile frameworks, Professional Scrum, and Professional Agile Leadership (PAL-E)
* 7+ years of experience in industrial automation and systems integration
* 3+ years of leadership experience with accountability for team success
* Strong understanding of software and industrial systems development methodologies including Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, and related practices
* Proven ability to lead technical teams while balancing custome

**Company****:**
================

AHI agilon health, inc.

**Job Posting Location****:**
=============================

Remote - USA

**Job Title****:**
==================

Director, Quality Performance Operations

**Job Description****:**
========================

***Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship, now or in the future.***

The Director, Quality Operations is a hands-on, results-driven operator responsible for disciplined, scalable execution across HEDIS, Stars, clinical quality programs, and the In-Home Assessment (IHA) program. Reporting to the Senior Director, Quality, this role provides operational leadership for the Quality Operations team and directly oversees the Senior Program Manager, Quality Operations. The Director serves as the critical connection point between the centralized operations team and regional and market teams, between operations and technology, and alongside the Payor team with our health plan partners, ensuring priorities are clear, commitments are tracked, and work gets done. This role is built for a strong operator with a bias for action: someone who brings structure to complexity, holds teams and partners accountable, closes loops, and consistently delivers measurable improvement in quality results.

**Essential Job Function**s:

**1. Operational Leadership and Execution**

Lead the day-to-day operating model for enterprise quality programs, including HEDIS, Stars, ACO/MSSP quality initiatives, clinical quality programs, and the IHA program.

Execute priorities set by the Senior Director through annual operating plans, workstreams, milestones, accountabilities, and measurable outcomes.

Directly manage and develop the Senior Program Manager, Quality Operations, and provide leadership across the broader quality operations team.

Serve as the primary liaison between the centralized Quality Operations team and regional and market teams, ensuring enterprise priorities, workflows, and expectations are clearly communicated, adopted, and executed locally, and that market needs, barriers, and feedback are surfaced and resolved centrally.

Establish and run a disciplined operating cadence, including action-item tracking, issue logs, escalation paths, and KPI scorecards, so that commitments are owned, deadlines are met, and open items are driven to closure.

**2. IHA Program Oversig**ht

Own end-to-end operational oversight of the IHA program, including implementation planning, workflow design, market readiness, vendor coordination, KPI monitoring, and issue resolution.

Partner with market, clinical, analytics, coding, risk adjustment, and health plan teams to ensure IHA activities support quality and clinical objectives.

Monitor IHA program productivity, completion, quality, member experience, documentation, and downstream outcomes; implement corrective actions when results are below target.

Drive consistent IHA execution across regions and markets, holding vendors and internal partners accountable to targets and ensuring identified gaps and follow-up needs are closed.

**3. Quality Program Operation**s

Ensure operational readiness for HEDIS/Stars submissions, audits, roadmaps and health plan deliverables.

Coordinate enterprise and market-level quality calendars, dependencies, risks, and deliverables across cross-functional teams.

Drive continuous improvement by evaluating workflows, identifying root causes, and implementing scalable solutions.

**4. Technology Partnership and Prioritizatio**n

Serve as the liaison between Quality Operations and the Technology and Product teams, translating operational needs into clearly defined business requirements, use cases, and success measures.

Lead prioritization of quality-related technology requests and enhancements based on quality impact, operational risk, and timing; maintain a transparent backlog and roadmap in partnership with Technology.

**Sr. Director, Club Operations - Boston**

Overview

**WHO WE ARE**

Equinox is a category of one, setting the global standard for luxury health, wellness, and hospitality. Our spaces are intentionally elevated, our standards uncompromising, and our expectations high. We attract people who take pride in excellence, care deeply about quality, and want to be part of something that feels different the moment you walk through the door.

We are builders, operators, and innovators who believe great environments and meaningful human connection change lives. Diversity, belonging, and ownership aren’t slogans here, they’re how we work. At Equinox, colleagues don’t just support the business; they shape the future of wellness. Because for us, it’s not fitness. It’s life.

**WHAT WE DO**

We create premium, immersive experiences where performance, hospitality, design, and human connection converge-and every detail matters. This is not a traditional fitness environment. It is a place where high standards, accountability, and pride in craft define the work.

Fueled by an entrepreneurial mindset, we trust our people with real responsibility and real impact. Growth is earned through action, learning is hands‑on, and careers are built by those who want to operate at the highest level. At Equinox, we don’t just offer opportunities-we offer long‑term pathways for people who want to do meaningful work in an environment that expects more and delivers more.

Job Description 
Reporting to the Regional Vice President of Operations, the Sr. Club Operations Director will be responsible for maintaining Equinox Standards across an assigned market area. This leadership role demands a deep understanding of Club management, with a focus on driving sales, enhancing the member experience, and ensuring that the Equinox’s luxury image is consistently upheld. The Sr. Director of Club Operations will lead and manage a group of General Managers and will with closely to lead Club and Ancillary teams, implement strategic initiatives and hold teams accountable for delivering results. The Sr. Director of Club Operations will have a strong presence in driving membership sales, maintaining operational excellence, and fostering a culture of success, guided by our core values.

**Operations Management**

* Member experience and satisfaction
* Facilities maintenance and cleanliness
* Staff management and development
* Group fitness programming
* Personal training programs
* Compliance with safety and hygiene standards

**Financial Performance**

* Achieve revenue targets and control expenses
* Manage budgets and analyze financial reports
* Identify opportunities for growth and profitability

**Team Leadership**

* Recruit, hire, train, and develop department managers
* Foster a positive and collaborative work environment
* Motivate and inspire staff to achieve goals
* Conduct performance reviews and provide feedback

**Member Engagement**

* Build relationships with members and address their needs
* Resolve member complaints and issues
* Create a welcoming and inclusive atmosphere
* Brand Standards:
* Ensure adherence to Equinox brand guidelines and service standards
* Maintain a high level of professionalism and presentation

\*

* Implement marketing and promotional initiatives

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Daily**

* Team Engagement - huddles, meetings, workouts
* Coaching GMs - Focusing on leadership and strategy
* Club Visit and Walk Through - 1-2 clubs/day
* 1on1 business meetings with GMs, AGMs and Regional Leaders

* Review clubs appointments - previous day activities (prospects, sales, equifits)
* Structured 1on1 GM Meetings - 30 min in person at least 2-3x/week
* Schedule Accountability - Checking schedules on arcon, verifying in person

**Monthly**

* GM & AGM development - ensuring it's happening (either directly or GM is delivering), schedule, reviews, learning

* People Pipeline - Staffing for future needs, identifying talent for growth
* Sales Strategy and Acco

**About CCNC:**

From the mountains to the coast, from large cities to small towns, Community Care of North Carolina is transforming health care. Informed by statewide data and predictive analytics, community-based care-managers work with local physicians and diverse teams of health professionals to develop whole-person plans of care that connect people to the right local resources and increase equity and access to high quality care.

**CCNC Mission Statement**

To improve the health and quality of life for all North Carolinians by building supporting better community-based healthcare delivery systems.

**Position Summary**
====================

The Director of Quality Improvement (QI) Strategy is responsible for setting the vision for the organization’s Quality Improvement strategy, in collaboration with the Population Health Division and aligned with CCNC’s mission and strategic goals. The aim of the QI strategy is to ensure the CCPN member practices deliver high - quality health care that drives successful performance of the Clinically Integrated Network (CIN).

The Director of Quality Improvement (QI) Strategy in coordination with the Clinical Performance and Practice Engagement teams, will direct, plan, implement, monitor, coordinate, and evaluate all aspects of the QI strategy and oversee daily operations to ensure that CCNC’s strategic plan is implemented. implements and informs process improvement to create standardized and streamlined processes, workflows, and education. The Director of QI Strategy provides direct supervision of the QI Specialist and the Value Based Care Program Specialist.

Responsibilities include outreach, education, training, hands-on participative leadership, and development of an increased capacity to successfully execute performance improvement across the organization. Working directly with others across the organization, The Director of Quality Improvement (QI) Strategy ensures that the elements of the QI strategy allow for coordination and collaboration of multifaceted initiatives with practices that serve our covered populations with consideration of resources, cost savings and quality. This includes providing strategic input on the development of organizational goals, to include measurement criteria and interventions for achieving the goals.

**Essential Functions**
=======================

**Operationalize QI Strategy**
------------------------------

* Direct the implementation of Quality Improvement efforts to support CCPN practices and CCNC programming in accordance with the strategic plan.
* Establish and implement the process for how PRRs utilize the QI plans to drive performance with CCPN practices.
* Facilitate the development of programs, systems, workflows, and integration efforts in alignment with CCNC and CCPN’s contractual, regulatory and quality requirements.
* Apply QI methodology, change management strategies, team facilitation, and coaching principles to achieve program effectiveness and efficiencies.
* Mentor and train on QI methodology, change management, and coaching principles (e.g. Model for Improvement, PDSA, Lean,).
* Demonstrate subject matter expertise and knowledge of payment models and their associated quality measures.
* Serve as the subject matter expert and lead for key projects and initiatives; including developing detailed work plans, assigning responsibilities, monitoring project progress and ensuring spread and sustainability.
* Assist CCPN and CCNC with future program development, creation or delegation of accountability and ownership for program roles and continuous process improvement.
* Develop annual Quality Plans with the Value Based Care Program practices in coordination with key focus areas identified by Clinical Performance.
* Represent and demonstrate our QI strategy in monthly Joint Operating Council meetings with the Value Based Care Program practices.
* Support the Practice Based Care Coordination (PBCC) program through data mining, identifica

**About Tufts Medicine**

Tufts Medicine brings together the best of academic and community medicine to deliver exceptional, connected and accessible care. Comprised of Tufts Medical Center, the principal teaching hospital of Tufts University and the Tufts University School of Medicine, Lowell General Hospital, MelroseWakefield Hospital, Lawrence Memorial Hospital of Medford, Care at Home, and an integrated network of 2,300 physicians, we treat the most complex conditions, keep our communities healthy and bring research breakthroughs to life.

**Job Overview**

This position reports to the Vice President of the Community Practice Operations (South and West) & Network Integration and serves as a key leader within Ambulatory at Tufts Medicine. The role provides operational and strategic oversight across the West region and in alignment with Ambulatory within the broader Tufts network.

In addition, this leader will oversee the Tufts Medicine Multi-Specialty location in Framingham, as well as Norfolk, including not only operations, but also growth within these practices. Operating within a collaborative leadership model and with a focus on service excellence in the ambulatory environment, this position is accountable for:

* Ensuring high-quality patient access and experience
* Driving financial performance and profitability
* Optimizing all revenue cycle processes
* Advancing strategic initiatives across the region and potentially across Ambulatory as a whole, when designated

This role plays a critical part in shaping the Tufts Medicine ambulatory strategy, enhancing operational effectiveness, and supporting the delivery and expansion of exceptional care within the community.

Location: Hybrid and at sites within the designated region (e.g., Framingham & Norfolk)

1. Bachelor's degree in business, healthcare, or a related field or equivalent combination of education and experience such as Associate’s degree in business, healthcare, or a related field and two (2) years of relevant business experience or High School Diploma or GED and four (4) years of relevant business experience.

2. Seven (7) years of healthcare management or practice management experience working directly with physicians and practice members.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

1. Master’s degree in business, healthcare, or a related field.

2. Ten (10) years of healthcare management or practice management experience working directly with physicians and practice members.

**Duties and Responsibilities:** The duties and responsibilities listed below are intended to describe the general nature of work and are not intended to be an all-inclusive list. Other duties and responsibilities may be assigned.

1. Directs the practice operations managers in the day-to-day operations of their employed outpatient physician practices to ensure each practice is meeting optimal operational efficiency, fiscal stability and patient/employee satisfaction.

2. Collaborates with the practice operations managers in the implementation of best practice models in all areas of practices operations. Develops guidelines for prioritizing work activities, evaluating effectiveness and modifying activities as necessary.

3. Evaluates practice efficiency including all personnel (physicians, clinical and administrative support staff) utilizing accepted quality measures, productivity standards, skill mix comparisons, and patient satisfaction survey data. Implements new operational models and structures to reduce cost, improve efficiency and quality, and enhance services to patients.

4. Participates in the development of and oversees budgets for the practices. Reviews monthly P&L reports in detail, determines opportunities for improvements, and creates and implements action plans with practice operations managers as necessary.

5. Conducts monthly operations team meetings to review new policies and procedures, processes, quality measures, etc., and

Description:

The Plant Manager is a senior leader responsible for planning, directing, and controlling activities of a plant to accomplish budgeted operational and financial objectives. Directs all functions at the plant including production, quality control, finance, purchasing, inventory control, manufacturing, engineering, and employee relations. The ideal candidate is a hands-on, data-driven leader capable of scaling production capacity, optimizing labor efficiency, managing complex capital projects, and building a high-performing, engaged workforce.

This role is responsible for the achievement of all operational financial goals. The responsibility also includes establishing and managing operational policies and procedures, creating and maintaining a safe and quality-minded work environment, and fostering the development of a well-trained and motivated work force at all levels.

LALA US Omaha Dairy manufactures yogurt smoothies and pourable sour cream. The facility provides a clean work environment, well-lit, highly automated production facility and career advancement opportunities. LALA US provides a competitive total compensation package including:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401k with company match
* Vacation and Personal time off
* 10 paid holidays
* Company-paid life, AD&D, short-term disability and long-term disability insurance
* Employee Assistance Program

**Core Responsibilities**

**1. People leadership, talent development & labor relations**

* Recruit, mentor, and evaluate department manager, superintendent and shift supervisors, establishing clear accountability and succession plans.
* Foster positive employee relations, high retention, and strong shop-floor morale through transparent communication, town halls, and recognition programs.
* Manage collective bargaining agreement administration, grievance resolution, and constructive relationships with union leadership.

**2. Production & operational execution**

* Direct multi-shift manufacturing operations to consistently achieve daily, weekly, and monthly production schedules and On-Time In-Full delivery targets.
* Monitor and improve key performance indicators, including Overall Equipment Effectiveness, scrap rates, yield, labor variance, and cycle times.
* Optimize production scheduling, capacity planning, and bottleneck management in partnership with Supply Chain and Materials teams.

**3. Financial management & P&L ownership**

* Develop, manage, and justify the annual plant operating budget, focusing on direct/indirect labor costs, raw material utilization, and overhead absorption.
* Track, analyze, and drive corrective actions on manufacturing cost variances, specifically Material Usage Variance, Labor Efficiency Variance, Scrap/Yield losses to protect margins.
* Partner with Engineering, Quality, and Supply Chain to investigate unfavorable material usage variances caused by Bill of Materials inaccuracies, machine calibration drift, or substandard raw materials.
* Conduct monthly financial variance reviews with corporate finance to identify cost-saving opportunities and mitigate inflationary pressures.

**4. Continuous improvement & operational excellence**

* Embed Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies (CILA, Centerline, 5S, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, TPM, SMED) into daily floor operations.
* Lead cross-functional continuous improvement events aimed at eliminating waste, reducing changeover times, and improving throughput.
* Leverage Manufacturing Execution Systems and ERP data to drive predictive decision-making and real-time floor visibility.

**5. Environmental, health, and safety leadership**

* Champion a zero-incident safety culture by enforcing strict adherence to OSHA regulations, Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures, and company safety policies.
* Lead root-cause investigations for all near-misses, recordable incidents, and environmental excursions, ensuring timely corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

record.ROLE_TEXT:
Franklin Biolabs emerges from the esteemed legacy of Dr. Jim Wilson's laboratory, a beacon of innovation in vector technology for over three decades. Building on this rich heritage, Franklin Biolabs is poised to redefine the landscape of the global genetic medicines industry. As a Contract Research Organization (CRO), Franklin Biolabs offers a comprehensive suite of services spanning from discovery through clinical manufacturing. Our goal is to empower our partners by providing unparalleled solutions that drive the advancement of genetic medicines. Leveraging decades of expertise and a commitment to excellence, we bridge the gap between groundbreaking research and ensuring that transformative therapies reach those who need them most.

Franklin Biolabs is in search of a successful QC GMP Analytical Laboratory Director who combines deep scientific expertise with proven regulatory knowledge and business leadership. The individual is capable of managing complex GMP testing operations, leading regulatory inspections, driving continuous improvement initiatives, developing high-performing teams, and ensuring the delivery of accurate, reliable, and compliant analytical results that support product quality and patient safety.

The Director of QC GMP Analytical Laboratory is responsible for the strategic leadership, operational management, and regulatory compliance of the Quality Control analytical testing laboratory supporting GMP manufacturing, product release, stability programs, method qualification/validation, and investigational/commercial products. This role ensures the generation of high-quality analytical data in compliance with FDA, EMA, ICH, USP, and applicable global regulatory requirements while maintaining inspection readiness and fostering a culture of quality, scientific excellence, and continuous improvement.

The Director provides leadership for laboratory personnel, oversees testing activities across multiple analytical platforms, manages laboratory budgets and resources, and serves as a key quality and technical representative during client interactions, regulatory inspections, and internal audits.

**Key Responsibilities**

Leadership & Laboratory Management

* Direct all QC analytical laboratory operations supporting GMP testing and product release.
* Develop and implement laboratory strategies aligned with organizational goals and regulatory requirements.
* Lead, mentor, and develop managers, scientists, analysts, and technical staff.
* Establish performance metrics and monitor laboratory productivity, turnaround times, and quality indicators.
* Build a culture focused on data integrity, compliance, quality, accountability, and scientific excellence.
* Manage staffing plans, succession planning, recruitment, and employee development.

GMP Compliance & Quality Systems

* Ensure laboratory activities comply with current GMP (cGMP), GLP where applicable, and data integrity requirements.
* Maintain inspection readiness for regulatory agencies and client audits.
* Lead investigations involving OOS, OOT, laboratory deviations, CAPAs, and change controls.
* Review and approve analytical reports, protocols, investigations, and technical documents.
* Ensure compliance with ALCOA+ principles for data integrity.
* Support responses to regulatory observations and inspection findings.

Analytical Testing Oversight

* Provide scientific and technical oversight for:
 + Chromatography (HPLC, UPLC, LC-MS/MS, GC)
 + Molecular assays (qPCR, ddPCR, NGS)
 + Cell-based assays and potency testing
 + Immunological assays (ELISA, MSD, flow cytometry)
 + Biophysical characterization methods
 - * Protein and peptide characterization
 * Stability studies
 * Environmental monitoring and raw material testing (as applicable)
 - Review analytical trends and implement corrective actions when necessary.
 - Oversee transfer, qualification, and validation of analytical methods.
 - Ensure timely completion of release and stability testing.

record.ROLE_TEXT:
The Director of Operations - Fire & Life Safety (FLS), is responsible for providing operational leadership, governance, and support across Bosch Building Technologies North America (Bosch BT NA) FLS projects & branch operations. Reporting to the Senior Vice President of Operations, this role partners closely with Branch Managers, Operations Managers, and Project Teams to drive consistent project execution, improve forecast accuracy, reduce operational risk, and strengthen financial performance.

The Director of Operations - Fire & Life Safety serves as a strategic operational leader focused on project health, resource optimization, excellence, and continuous improvement across the FLS business. The role ensures alignment to company standards and operational best practices while supporting branch teams in delivering successful outcomes for customers and stakeholders.

**Responsibilities:**

**Operational Leadership & Branch Support**

* Partner with Branch Managers and Operations Leaders to support execution of business objectives.
* Conduct regular branch operational reviews to evaluate project health, financial performance, staffing, backlog, and forecast accuracy.
* Provide leadership and guidance for complex operational issues and escalated project concerns.
* Support organizational consistency across all FLS operations.

**Project Governance & Risk Management**

* Oversee project review programs throughout the project lifecycle.
* Identify operational, contractual, financial, and execution risks on large projects.
* Facilitate risk mitigation strategies and recovery planning.
* Support margin improvement initiatives and reduction of project deviations.
* Ensure project controls and governance standards are consistently followed.
* Drive consistent execution standards across all FLS operations.

**Financial & Operational Performance**

* Review project forecasts, earned revenue, gross margin performance, labor utilization, and backlog health.
* Partner with branch leadership on annual planning, budgeting, and forecasting activities.
* Drive accountability for operational KPIs and project financial performance.
* Improve forecast accuracy and operational predictability

**Process Standardization & Continuous Improvement**

* Implement operational best practices and playbooks.
* Support standardization of project execution methodologies.
* Identify opportunities for productivity improvements and workflow efficiencies.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives across assigned branches.

**Cross Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate with Engineering, Sales, Procurement, Service, and Finance teams.
* Support seamless project transitions from sales through execution and into service.
* Ensure operational alignment with strategic organizational objectives.

**Health, Safety & Compliance**

* Promote a culture of operational excellence and safety.
* Ensure compliance with customer requirements, company policies, and regulatory standards.

**Supervisor Duties:**

In accordance with applicable Company policies/procedures and Federal/State laws, will perform the following supervisory responsibilities: planning, assigning, and directing work; coaching and appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

**Job Description**
===================

This role defines how the GE Vernova Gas Power portfolio should evolve over a 5-year horizon and leads the front end of the hardware portfolio and NPI funnel. The leader converts shifts in customer needs, energy markets, technology, policy, competition, and adjacent value pools into an integrated portfolio architecture, prioritized opportunity pipeline, and decision-ready investment recommendations across heavy-duty gas turbines, aeroderivative gas turbines, steam turbines, generators, heat-recovery and balance-of-plant systems, equipment controls, and integrated engine and plant architectures.

 
 

The role matures outyear hardware and engine-solution opportunities until customer value, strategic fit, architecture, technical feasibility, economics, risk, ownership, and execution pathways are sufficiently defined for a Product Management decision. At that point, accountability transitions through a formal tollgate to Product Management, which owns funded commercialization, product roadmap execution, lifecycle performance, quality, delivery, and product cost.

 
 

Expected to work in a high intensity, sprint-based model, with high exposure to Power SLT on business-defining recommendations.

 
 

**Scope boundaries within the Strategy & Product Management team**
------------------------------------------------------------------

**Joint seams:** Data centers, distributed generation, hybrid systems and other cross-portfolio opportunities require a named lead by value proposition. This role leads when the core question is engine, equipment, controls or plant architecture; Software & Services Strategy leads when the core question is digital/services value capture; New Business Industrialization leads when the opportunity requires venture incubation or formation of a new business.

**Owned by New Business Industrialization:** Startup-like opportunities, external or emerging technologies requiring venture-style incubation, new business models, sandbox or stand-alone operating structures, early commercialization, and industrialization pathways outside the established hardware portfolio. This role may identify or sponsor a signal, but transfers venture incubation accountability.

**Owned by Software & Services Strategy:** Software products, industrial data and AI, digital platforms, recurring-revenue models, software-enabled services, services transformation, installed-base service strategy, and the enterprise value proposition that combines software, controls and services. This role supplies hardware and controls-interface requirements but does not own that strategy.

**Owned by this role:** Long-range hardware portfolio architecture; heavy-duty and aeroderivative engine platforms; steam, generator and balance-of-plant hardware; equipment controls and controls interfaces; new centerlines and derivatives; physical plant and power-island architectures; hardware competitiveness; and transition of defined opportunities into Product Management/NPI.

 
 

**Organizational scope**
------------------------

* Reports directly into the VP Power Strategy, with a formal operating interlock to the head of Product Management and the Power executive leadership team.

* Leads 4-6 direct reports plus cross-functional opportunity teams formed around priority initiatives.

* Global scope across new units, installed base, services, software and controls, digital offerings, engine and plant-system solutions, and selected adjacencies.

* Owns portfolio recommendations and incubation governance, not engineering line management, product P&Ls, commercial execution, or lifecycle delivery after transition.

* Decision rights include opportunity admission, evidence requirements, incubation funding recommendations, gate-readiness certification, and stop/pivot recommendations. Final investment approvals remain with designated business governance.

 
 

Required Qualifications

 
 

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, bus

**Plant Manager**

Department: Operations / Manufacturing

Reports To: Director of Operations

Direct Reports: Production Managers, Facilities Manager, and other assigned manufacturing leadership

Scope: Three manufacturing buildings / multi-product HVAC manufacturing operation

**Position**

The Plant Manager is responsible for the overall leadership, performance, and day-to-day execution of manufacturing operations across three buildings within a large HVAC manufacturing facility. This position provides hands-on leadership to ensure the plant safely produces high-quality products on schedule, at the required volume and cost, while developing a strong culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

The Plant Manager is responsible for coordinating production activities across multiple manufacturing processes and buildings, including assembly, sheet metal fabrication, welding, piping/refrigeration, testing, material flow, and final product completion.

The successful candidate will establish clear operating standards, drive cross-functional accountability, develop manufacturing leadership, remove operational constraints, and ensure the plant has the people, processes, equipment, and infrastructure required to support current production and future growth.

This position is expected to be highly visible on the manufacturing floor and serves as the primary operational leader responsible for translating business objectives into daily execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Plant Leadership & Operational Execution**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for manufacturing operations across all three buildings.
* Establish daily, weekly, and monthly operating priorities aligned with business requirements.
* Ensure production plans are executed safely, efficiently, and according to customer commitments.
* Maintain strong communication and coordination between buildings and manufacturing departments.
* Establish clear ownership and accountability for production performance.
* Lead daily plant operating reviews and ensure corrective actions are completed.
* Identify and remove constraints affecting throughput, capacity, quality, or delivery.
* Maintain appropriate production capacity, staffing, equipment, and infrastructure to support business growth.
* Ensure standardized processes are consistently followed across all buildings.
* Maintain a strong management presence on the manufacturing floor.

**2. Production Management**

* Lead Production Managers and ensure effective management of production personnel.
* Establish production priorities based on customer demand, capacity, material availability, and schedule requirements.
* Ensure production schedules are achieved while balancing labor, equipment, materials, and testing capacity.
* Monitor production flow from fabrication through final assembly and testing.
* Develop and maintain effective production metrics and visual management systems.
* Identify bottlenecks and implement corrective actions to improve throughput.
* Ensure appropriate escalation processes are in place when production performance is at risk.
* Coordinate production activities between the three buildings to maximize overall plant capacity.

**3. Safety, Environmental & Compliance**

* Establish safety as the facility’s highest operational priority.
* Partner with EHS leadership to maintain a strong safety culture across all three buildings.
* Ensure compliance with OSHA, environmental regulations, company requirements, and applicable industry standards.
* Drive accountability for safe work practices at all levels of the organization.
* Ensure timely investigation and corrective action following incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions.
* Support programs designed to reduce injuries, ergonomic risks, environmental impacts, and workplace hazards.

**Eagle Title | Annapolis, MD**

**Compensation Range:** Compensation is a combination of base salary plus performance-based commission tied to profitability and revenue growth across the branches.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

Eagle Title is looking for a Director of Branch Operations to lead the profitability, growth, and operational excellence of Eagle Title branches (including Commercial and Builder Services Divisions).

Reporting directly to the President, this is a senior leadership role for someone who combines strong business acumen, operational expertise, and a proven ability to develop high-performing leaders. We're looking for someone who takes ownership of results, holds branch managers accountable for growing their businesses, and builds the strategies, systems, and relationships needed for long-term success.

The right person understands that strong financial performance starts with strong leadership, clear expectations, efficient operations, and exceptional client service.

**WHAT YOU'LL LEAD**

**Branch Profitability & Growth**

* Own the profit and loss (P&L) performance of all branches, driving profitability, revenue growth, and operational efficiency.
* Establish financial goals, growth expectations, and key performance indicators (KPIs) for each branch.
* Hold branch managers accountable for executing strategies that grow the business, strengthen referral relationships, and achieve revenue targets.
* Regularly review branch financial and operational performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and implement strategies that deliver measurable results.

**Branch Operations & Strategy**

* Provide strategic and operational oversight of branches, ensuring consistency, accountability, efficiency, and exceptional client service.
* Support branch managers in overseeing day-to-day operations, resolving challenges, and maintaining effective workflows.
* Develop and execute branch strategies that align with Eagle Title's financial goals and long-term business objectives.
* Establish standardized processes, performance expectations, and operational best practices across locations.
* Leverage technology, data, and continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen efficiency, quality, and scalability.

**Leadership & Accountability**

* Lead, coach, and develop branch managers through clear expectations, regular performance discussions, measurable goals, and consistent accountability.
* Establish and monitor branch manager scorecards that track financial performance, business development activity, operational efficiency, and client satisfaction.
* Partner with Human Resources to support staffing, training, performance management, and leadership development.
* Empower branch managers to take ownership of their teams, business development efforts, and overall branch performance.
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, problem-solving, and continuous improvement.

**Collaboration & Business Performance**

* Serve as a strategic business partner to Underwriting, Post-Closing, Marketing and other operational departments to strengthen workflows, resolve challenges, and deliver exceptional client experience.
* Collaborate with the President and Sales leadership to align branch growth strategies with overall company objectives.
* Identify and address operational challenges affecting transaction quality, turnaround times, profitability, and client satisfaction.
* Strengthen communication and collaboration across departments to support successful transactions and organizational growth.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* Proven leadership experience overseeing multiple branches, locations, or business units with responsibility for financial and operational performance.
* Strong understanding of P&L management, budgeting, financial analysis, and revenue growth strategies.
* Demonstrated success driving profitability, operational efficiency, and measurable business results.
