record.ROLE_TEXT:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 

Job Description:

The Senior Air Vehicle Operator (AVO) – Deployment Operations is responsible for executing and leading V-BAT flight operations in support of DoD and foreign customers in both land-based and maritime OCONUS environments. This is an operationally focused role requiring strong aviation judgment, disciplined execution, and the ability to lead small teams in austere and high-visibility conditions. 

 

The Senior AVO is responsible for leading mission planning activities, performing comprehensive risk assessments, delivering pre-mission briefings, executing flight operations, and conducting structured post-flight debriefs. This role includes conducting Functional Check Flights (FCFs) and system validation as required, ensuring aircraft configuration control and logbook accuracy, coordinating with maintenance to sustain fleet readiness, and supporting overall operational discipline. The Senior AVO will mentor junior operators, serve as the on-site operational representative to customers, and travel extensively in support of deployments. 

 

This is not an entry-level flight operations role. The ideal candidate brings strong aviation fundamentals, disciplined cockpit habits, and mature operational decision-making. They must be comfortable leading deployments, briefing customers, managing risk in dynamic environments, and maintaining professionalism in high-visibility settings. The Senior AVO must balance mission execution with customer satisfaction while upholding the highest standards of safety, compliance, and operational excellence. 

Required Qualifications:

 - Minimum of 2000 documented unmanned flight hours or 1000 manned flight hours 

 - Demonstrated instructor experience (manned or unmanned aviation)  

 - FAA Private Pilot License (PPL)  

 - FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate 

 - Ability to obtain and maintain an FAA Class II Medical Certificate 

 - Ability to obtain and hold a Secret DoD security clearance 

 - Ability to pass background, drug screening, and customer-required medical/dental screenings 

 - Willingness to travel up to 50–75% in support of deployments 

 - Ability to lead and operate independently in small teams under austere conditions 

 - Strong aviation judgment, decision-making, and risk management skills 

Preferred Qualifications

 - FAA Instrument Rating and/or Commercial Pilot License  

 - Experience operating as aircrew on manned aircraft  

 - Prior military service, particularly with overseas or deployed operations  

 - Maritime or shipboard UAS operational experience  

 - Previous experience as a Site Lead or in a leadership role overseeing aviation operations   

#LI-JM1

#LD

 

Full-time regular employee offer package:

Pay within range listed + Bonus + Benefits + Equity

 

Temporary employee offer package:

Pay within range listed above + temporary benefits package (applicable after 60 days of employment)

 

Salary compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, licenses and certifications, and specific work location. All offers are contingent on a cleared background and possible reference check. Military fellows and part-time employees are not eligible for benefits. **Director of Operations**

At **MPE** we are dedicated to making a difference in the world through cutting-edge medical technology. Our mission is to be the global leader in design, engineering, and manufacturing solutions for the medical and technology industries. We are committed to creating impactful solutions that improve lives and fostering an environment where our team members can thrive, grow, and contribute to groundbreaking advancements in the medical field.

**A better career for you. Creating medical technology for all.**

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**We are seeking a dedicated Director of Operations to join our team.**

In this vital role, you will be responsible for all of the Company’s Manufacturing and Maintenance activities related to all MPE sites. The Director of Operations will plan, direct, coordinate, and oversee operations activities in the organization, ensuring development and implementation of efficient operations and cost-effective systems to meet current and future needs of the organization.

If you enjoy working in a fast-paced environment where precision and teamwork matter, we’d love to hear from you!

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Serve as a key member of the Leadership Team that develops, establishes, communicates and executes the strategic direction of operations while aligning with overall business goals and objectives and supporting customer requirements.
* Work closely with President/CEO to drive manufacturing plans, goals and future innovations including Lean, Six Sigma, Quick Response Manufacturing techniques and Continuous Improvement to evolve our World Class Organization.
* Ensure that, as the Company grows, our manufacturing capabilities meet or exceed industry and customer requirements for cost, quality, responsiveness, lean, efficiencies, safety and best practices.
* Develop, recommend and manage budgeting and budget execution within functional area with a focus on costs savings, productivity improvements and quality assurance. Manage within the budgetary constraints. Analyze and report on variances between actual and budgeted expenditures
* Oversee all manufacturing engineering, production control, production process development, and preventive maintenance.
* Develop and implement processes, procedures and controls to promote efficient operations of the organization and ensure all Operations teams remain compliant to the processes, procedures and controls.
* Work closely with the Quality Team to ensure manufacturing processes are meeting customers’ requirements and required scorecard levels.
* Monitor and understand our customers’ and other outside agencies regulatory and quality system requirements and incorporate into our manufacturing processes while maintaining compliance.
* Ensure the training of new and present employees in the processes and methods required to achieve the organization’s standards for quality, quantity, and safety, consistent with the companies compliance and operational needs. Identifies additional training needs and ensures proper training is developed and provided.
* Oversee the Company’s environmental, health and safety efforts in manufacturing to remain in compliance OSHA, EPA, State and local regulations and provide a safe working environment for our employees.
* Establish and maintain best practices for Manufacturing and Preventive Maintenance to develop and run a world-class manufacturer for medical devices. Ensure the maintenance of departmental housekeeping standards.
* Maintains knowledge of emerging technologies and trends in operations management.
* Presents periodic performance reports and metrics to the Chief Executive Officer and Leadership Team.
* Leader and Ambassador for MP

**The Role**
------------

The Director, Site Operations leads all aspects of our plant operations ranging from the cultivation of cannabis through distribution and everything in between. As the Director, Site Operations, you'll direct all the daily processes and long-term targets for the facility. You'll grind away at the details of managing internal resources to maximize safety, compliance, efficiency, productivity and culture. You'll also blaze the path toward creating and developing the multilevel professional team, and you'll work closely with your management team to keep every detail of the facility up to standards.

**Essential Functions**
-----------------------

* Oversee all strategic planning and vision for facility plant operations for cultivation, processing, packaging, maintenance, quality and logistics/fulfillment
* Manager all facility activities working closely with departmental managers ensuring wholesale objectives are accomplished on time and budget
* Own the facility budget; Analyze facility data, including efficiency metrics, labor variance analysis, defect rates, cost drivers, volume and capacity planning, etc. to make recommendations on optimal quality and efficiency improvements and capital expenditures
* Develop and produce reporting to clearly illustrate the trends of the business
* Manage and maintain a company culture consistent with the culture established at Green Thumb corporate of accountability, transparency and enjoyment
* Participate in developing and implementing rules, regulations, policies, and procedures to advance Green Thumb's mission, vision, goals and objectives
* Continuously improve the skills, knowledge and morale of all employees; create an environment where the entire team does the same
* Implement and maintain wholesale facility and equipment preventative maintenance program; replace, or make adjustments to plant facilities and equipment when necessary
* Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal billing or licensing requirements
* Will be required to be on-call and to respond to emergency situations at any time. This may include scheduling issues, potentially covering a vacant shift, facility issues and/or human resources requirements
* Other duties as assigned

**Safety & Compliance**
-----------------------

* Be aware of hazards in the workspace.
* Retain and understand department specific training.
* Be compliant with area safety requirements, state regulations and PPE requirements while at GTI sites.
* Follow GMP, biosecurity, sanitation or other quality and compliance requirements.
* Perform record keeping accurately and completely as directed by a lead or supervisor.
* Report and escalate safety & quality concerns.

**Working Conditions**
----------------------

* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to perform reaching, grasping, bending, stooping, talking, hearing, seeing and repetitive motions.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, changing, and challenging environment
* Work involves daily exposure to allergens (such as cannabis, tree nuts, and coconut oil).
* Travel up to 10% may be required

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or Business required; MBA or similar preferred
* 10+ years of management experience in manufacturing environment; direct management of 100+ individuals in a manufacturing setting required
* Consumer Packaged Good experience required
* In-depth knowledge & understanding of Lean, Six Sigma, certifications a plus
* Exposure to horticulture and/or plant science and/or lab processing, a plus
* Strong commercial and financial acumen with experience managing a P&L required
* Can-do attitude and ability to adapt quickly; business is experiencing tremendous growth so previous operational experience in growth environment is substantially preferred
* Highly motivated, self-directed, innovative and able to work independently or among teams with keen judgement, common sense a

record.ROLE_TEXT:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

**The Opportunity:**

The Ashley Home Delivery (AHD) Operational Excellence Director provides centralized leadership for operational planning, routing, process development, project execution, vendor governance, performance management, and organizational coordination across Ashley Home Delivery. This role translates strategy into repeatable operating standards, disciplined execution, measurable performance, and scalable support.

The Director partners with field leadership and cross-functional teams to improve customer experience, delivery performance, carrier accountability, cost effectiveness, and launch readiness, enabling Regional Directors and market leaders to remain focused on field execution.

* Develop and maintain national AHD KPI definitions, reporting standards, scorecards, forecasts, and performance dashboards.

**Job Description:**

**Who We Are:**

At Cart.com, we're **defining the future of commerce.**

Founded to solve the growing complexity of modern commerce, Cart.com helps businesses simplify how they sell, fulfill, and deliver products to their customers. We bring together technology, services, and logistics infrastructure into one connected platform, making it easier for organizations to grow, operate efficiently, and navigate an increasingly fragmented commerce landscape.

We work with brands, retailers, manufacturers, and public sector organizations to support every stage of the customer journey, from ecommerce and order management to fulfillment, distribution, and delivery. By combining software, expertise, and a nationwide logistics network into a unified solution, we help our customers move faster, operate smarter, and scale with confidence.

But what truly sets Cart.com apart is our people. We're builders, problem-solvers, and innovators who thrive on turning big challenges into meaningful outcomes for our customers. Every day, we're helping shape the future of commerce while creating opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact.

If you're energized by solving complex problems, collaborating with talented teammates, and helping build what's next, we'd love to hear from you.

**Cart.com Milestones**

* Founded in 2020 with a vision to build the first truly unified commerce platform.
* Achieved unicorn status with a valuation exceeding $1 billion.
* Raised more than $475 million to support continued growth and innovation
* Expanded a nationwide commerce and logistics network that helps organizations scale, fulfill, and grow across channels.
* Recognized by Inc.'s Power Partner Awards for helping businesses grow and scale.
* Recognized as an award-winning employer for four consecutive years, reflecting our commitment to building an environment where talented people can grow, innovate, and make an impact.

**Our values:** Cart.com is building a company that is committed to living out these 6 core values:

* **Be brand obsessed:** Our lives are shaped by the brands we interact with daily. We obsess over the brands we serve, and about the things they care about.
* **Think beyond the box:** “We’ve always done it that way” is not a phrase uttered often at our office. We create creative solutions to complex problems.

* **Don’t give up:** We learn from our challenges and see them for what they are; great building blocks to an amazing brand story.
* **Speak up:** We communicate clearly and directly because we care deeply. Communication is the bedrock of our community.
* **Work together:** We’ve built a team that prides itself on diversity of thought and background. Collaboration is better with contrast.
* **Remember to be human:** We work hard, but we leave room for the people, places and things that we love

**AI is part of how we work. It's not doing the hiring.** 
 
We'll use AI in parts of our process and we think you should feel free to use it too — for research, prep, whatever helps. But our interviews exist to meet *you*, not your best AI-assisted draft. Real people make every call here. Any questions about how this works, just ask.

**Remote:**

This position is fully remote and open to candidates in AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, DE, FL, GA, HI, IL, IN, KY, LA, MA, MD, MI, MO, MS, NC, NJ, NY, NC, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA. The salary range for this role is $175,000-200,000 annually. Actual compensation may vary based on geographic location, experience and qualifications. This role is eligible for bonus, equity and benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off. Applications accepted through 1-31-2027. We comply with all applicable pay transparency laws in the states where we operate.

**Location** Frederick, Maryland, United States **Job ID** R-264437 **Date posted** 15/11/2026

 

**Director Biochemical & Biophysical Methods**

**Reports to:** Senior Director, Global Technical Operations – Manufacturing Process and Analytical Science – Analytical

**Location:** Frederick, MD USA

Located on the Frederick, MD Manufacturing Campus, GTO operates a state-of-the-art laboratory equipped with modern analytical instrumentation and small-scale drug substance process capabilities—a truly one-of-a-kind asset within AZ Bio Ops. As Director of Biochemical & Biophysical Methods, you will lead a substantial part of this operation, managing a high-performing team of scientists who serve as subject matter experts (SMEs) for the biochemical and biophysical methods used to release and characterize our late-stage and commercial products. The team's core responsibilities include method validation and transfer, method lifecycle management, manufacturing investigation support, critical reagent qualification, and analytical testing in support of process improvement projects. You will also play a key strategic role in transforming analytical testing within AZ Bio by implementing innovative technologies, leveraging automation to replace manual workflows, and integrating advanced analytical technologies into upstream and downstream manufacturing processes. This is a leadership role where you will partner with peers across internal and external QC testing sites, other GTO functions, R&D, Quality, Regulatory, and Supply Chain organizations to ensure a continuous supply of medicines to patients.

**Typical Accountabilities:**
-----------------------------

* Lead a team that is responsible for execution of all biochemical and biophysical methods including capillary electrophoresis/focusing, HPLC, UPLC, mass spectrometry, circular dichroism, differential scanning calorimetry, and various spectroscopic techniques. Execution of this suite of assays typically support method validation, analytical tech transfer, critical reagent qualification, and process improvement projects.

* Plays a key role in identifying and implementing improvement projects within the lab function including integration of automation/liquid handling into workflows, use of generative AI for report generation, data compilation, and review. Works cross-functionally with peers across the organization to help define next generation analytical strategy across the company.

* Maintain GTO’s lab space in a state of GMP compliance.

* Be able to troubleshoot biochemical and biophysical methods.

* **To succeed in this role, you will need to be self-motivated, innovative, have strong technical and communication skills, and a deep understanding of protein chemistry and relevant methods used to release biological products.**

* **Mentors and develops staff of approximately eight direct reports; this is a people manager role.**

**Education, Qualifications, Skills, and Experience**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree technical field such as Pharmacy, Biology, Chemistry.

* Preferred advanced degree (MS or PhD) in a scientific field

* Subject matter expert in multiple biochemical and biophysical methods including HPLC, UPLC, capillary electrophoresis/focusing, mass spectrometry, circular dichroism, and differential scanning calorimetry.

* Minimum 10 years of experience working in the pharmaceutical industry.

* Working experience in supervisory / managerial roles within quality in the Pharmaceutical Industry.

* Experience working with regulatory / SOP / GxP requirements and driving compliance.

* Leading complex projects / operations in terms of resources, vendors, and budgets.

* Driving substantial change initiatives through internal/external teams and partners

The Director, Manufacturing Talent Programs at Phenom is a client-facing, revenue-accountable executive role focused on diagnosing and resolving talent-related constraints for healthcare clients. This position is responsible for conducting in-depth research, building financial models, and engaging senior leadership to drive strategic growth. The Director leads the full client engagement cycle, from initial research to contract closure, ensuring each opportunity is client-validated and measurable. The role offers a competitive compensation package of $250,000–$300,000+ OTE, comprehensive benefits, flexible scheduling, and opportunities for professional growth within a diverse and inclusive organization.

**Job Requirements** 

**Job Description**

Phenom is an applied AI company with a bold mission: help a billion people find the right work. Our Plant Manager is responsible for the daily production processing of our Laundry facility. Managing the employees in our production, warehouse, and maintenance departments, you will be responsible for monitoring production flow, controlling costs, maintaining quality standards, and regulating product inventory. Managerial duties include all staffing, transfer, promotion, coaching, training, terminating, and employee review responsibilities.

**Requirements:**

* We require 1+ years of managerial or supervisory experience, in a production environment
* Qualified candidates should have previous experience controlling budgets, setting schedules, and meeting production deadlines
* Production-line scheduling experience
* Staff scheduling experience
* Lean management experience utilizing computer controls
* Must be growth oriented and career minded
* Good communication skills are required
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred but not required
* Bachelors Degree Preferred.

**Benefits of working at Prudential Overall Supply:**

* Competitive hourly rate. We know your time and hard work is valuable!
* Exceptional Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* Paid Time Off for vacation, holidays and sick time
* Full Tuition Reimbursement
* Paid Life Insurance
* 401K with company match
* Profit sharing. When we do well as a company, you do well!
* Regular work schedule, Monday – Friday
* Uniform Provided
* Employee Discounts
* Career development and advancement within the company. Let us help you reach your goals!

**Company History:** Since 1932, Prudential Overall Supply continues to provide best-in-class solutions for a business’ uniform and textile needs. Service programs include uniform rental, uniform lease, uniform purchase for industrial uniform programs and related services. We have been deemed essential in the services we provide to our clients and community. Prudential is grateful for the exceptional work produced by our industry-best tenured employees, and to our exceptional customer patronage. It is this connection that enables Prudential to provide our customers with the best possible products and service at a fair price, today and into the future.

**Equal Opportunity Employer:** Prudential Overall Supply is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or employing any individual on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, ancestry, religion, physical or intellectual disability, age veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, pregnancy, citizenship, or any other factor protected by anti-discriminatory laws

**Job Overview:**

The Senior Manager, Quality & QMS is responsible for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continuously improving the Quality Management System (QMS) for Intech’s medical device manufacturing operations.

This position provides senior-level leadership for all site quality activities, including production quality, nonconformance management, CAPA, internal and external audits, supplier quality, document and record control, quality metrics, and continuous improvement. A primary responsibility of the role will be to lead the organization in developing and implementing an effective QMS and preparing the site for ISO 9001 certification.

This position will serve as the primary quality leader for the site and will work closely with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Product Development, and other functional leaders to ensure that quality is integrated into the business and manufacturing processes rather than operating as a separate inspection function. This role is a hands-on position and will operate strategically while also working directly with manufacturing personnel to establish practical, sustainable quality processes.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Own the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the site's Quality Management System.
* Lead the organization through its ISO 9001 readiness and certification process.
* Establish and maintain quality policies, procedures, work instructions, forms, records, and other QMS documentation.
* Establish effective document and record control processes.
* Develop quality objectives, metrics, and management-review processes.
* Ensure QMS processes are understood, implemented, and effective across the organization.
* Identify gaps, risks, and opportunities for improvement and develop practical plans to address them.
* Provide leadership for quality throughout the manufacturing process.
* Establish appropriate inspection, testing, sampling, and process-control requirements.
* Partner with Operations and Engineering to identify and eliminate sources of variation and defects.
* Monitor production quality performance and trends.
* Lead efforts to reduce scrap, rework, defects, and recurring quality issues.
* Ensure appropriate controls are in place for nonconforming product(s), product identification, traceability, and inspection status.
* Support process changes, equipment changes, product introductions, and manufacturing improvements from a quality perspective.
* Own and continuously improve the site's CAPA and nonconformance processes.
* Lead investigations into significant quality issues and recurring nonconformances.
* Establish effective root-cause analysis and corrective-action practices.
* Ensure corrective actions address systemic causes and are implemented and verified for effectiveness.
* Monitor CAPA and NCR trends to identify broader process and systemic issues.
* Establish appropriate escalation of significant quality risks to site leadership.
* Develop and manage the internal audit program.
* Conduct or oversee internal QMS and process audits.
* Coordinate customer, certification, surveillance, and other external audits.
* Serve as the primary quality contact during external audits.
* Ensure audit findings are appropriately investigated, corrected, and closed.
* Build an organization that is continuously audit-ready rather than preparing only immediately before an audit.
* Establish and maintain supplier quality processes.
* Develop supplier qualification, evaluation, monitoring, and re-evaluation practices.
* Establish supplier quality expectations in partnership with Supply Chain and Operations.
* Monitor supplier quality performance and trends.
* Lead or support supplier corrective actions.
* Participate in supplier selection and qualification activities as appropriate.
* Address recurring supplier issues through effective root-cause analysis and corrective action.

**Company Description**

Sirtex Medical is a global leader in healthcare, with offices in the U.S., Australia, Germany, and Singapore, dedicated to improving patient outcomes.

Our mission is to be at the forefront of minimally invasive cancer and embolization therapies. By partnering with physicians, we aim to provide innovative products that enhance patient outcomes and simplify treatments. Achieving this ambitious goal requires passionate and talented individuals who are committed to making a difference. Our flagship product, SIR-Spheres® Y-90 resin microspheres, is a targeted radiation therapy for liver cancer. To date, we have delivered over >150K doses across 50+ countries, significantly impacting patients' lives worldwide. Our success is fueled by our dedication to serving the medical community, maintaining professionalism, fostering a collaborative work culture, nurturing an entrepreneurial spirit, and continuously pursuing innovation and improvement.

At Sirtex, we are committed to creating a great workplace. We offer a range of benefits, programs, and services to support our employees, ensuring they have opportunities to contribute to our success and advance their careers. Join our inclusive community, where you can collaborate with talented colleagues, bring your ideas to life, and advance your career, all while delivering innovative healthcare solutions to patients.

 **Job Description**

**SCOPE:**

The Wilmington plant is the largest of 3 global Sirtex manufacturing site and serves as the principal production site of both SIR-Spheres microspheres and Lava product lines. The Plant Manager is responsible for leading the sites manufacturing operations, engineering, warehouse and product distribution.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

 

* Develop and lead execution of the site manufacturing strategy for both the SIR-Spheres and Lava value streams. Align site goals with Senior Leadership and Corporate objectives.
* Team Performance Management: lead, develop and mentor manufacturing team members.
* Manage production schedules, ensuring resource availability and capacity to meet demand, working closely with the Supply Chain team, using optimal schedules to minimize overall costs.
* Lead Continuous Improvement efforts, identifying process, equipment, product, and other opportunities, that reduce cost, improve quality and safety at the site.
* Full responsibility for developing and managing to site budget.
* Ensure resource and equipment capacity to ensure efficient and reliable manufacturing.
* Set site target KPI’s managing OEE, Labor Efficiency, Scrap, Equipment Utilization, etc.
* Ensure product is built to specification and in compliance with all Quality System requirements.
* Manage the site engineering team to ensure equipment and processes are robust and meet all manufacturing requirements. Manage PM strategy and ensure that execution is completed on time.
* Support the Quality Department, working with on site Quality team members to ensure that compliance with all areas of the Sirtex QMS are being followed. Identify opportunities for improvement and work to implement them directly in the QMS.
* Work in conjunction with HSE/Facilities Department to ensure a safe working environment for all employees and that the facilities is maintained, and compliant with regulatory requirements for both the handling of radioactive materials and medical device manufacturing.
* Manage all shipping, receiving and warehousing activities. Ensure timely material receipt, inventory accuracy is maintained, and products are shipped on time.

 
**Qualifications**

**EDUCATIONAL PREREQUISITES AND SKILL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or related discipline such as Chemistry or Biomedical field
* 5+ Years experience working in medical device or pharmaceutical industry preferred.
* Prior experience working with radioisotopes preferred.
* 3+ years of site management experience, with 10+ years of leadership experience.
* 6 Si

**Job Title:** Global Director, Supplier Quality

**Job Location:** Southfield, MI

**What we offer:**

VeoneerSafety Systemsis the world leader in Automotive Electronic Safety Systems. Veoneer’s scalable, best-in-class restraint control systems are mitigating the effects of a car crash. To date, we have delivered more than 1 billion devices to car manufacturers globally.
 
 
Veoneer Safety Systems has an international and collaborative team of 2,700 employees in 11 countries. We empower our people and are dedicated to their professional development and growth*.* 
 
Veoneer Safety Systems – Protect Everyone in Every Crash.

**What you'll do:**

The Global Director of Supplier Quality leads the global SQ organization, setting strategy, standards, and accountability for supplier readiness, performance, and continuous improvement.

The role combines global Supplier Quality leadership (80%) with North America Engineering Quality and Operational Quality leadership (20%).

**Key Responsibilities for Supplier Quality** (80% of role)

**Strategic Leadership & Global Deployment**

* Set global SQ strategy aligned with corporate, customer, sourcing, and manufacturing objectives.
* Define and execution of Supplier Quality Policies, Standards, Processes, Methods and Systems.
* Owner of Veoneer Supplier Manual (VSM), Supplier Quality Project (SQP) – APQP & PPAP, Supplier Non-Conformance Material (NCM) Management.
* Align cross-functional priorities, resources, and accountability; establish SQE oversight of workload, open issues, owners, overdue actions, and escalations.
* Monitor supplier quality targets, initiatives and indicators to ensure compliance to Veoneer Supplier Quality related policies, standards and reporting.

**Supplier Development & Standards Compliance**

* Oversee new supplier assessment, qualification, and development with Purchasing and Engineering; improve assessment models and ensure teams close risks and capability gaps before sourcing and production approval.
* Set common supplier requirements, risk-based audit and development expectations, and change controls; ensure existing suppliers improve capability and sustain company and customer compliance.
* Representing quality in Supplier Sourcing Board.

**Supplier Performance & Major Quality Issues**

* Lead major supplier escalations with supplier executives and cross-functional teams, ensuring containment, exposure assessment, production and customer protection, and verified permanent corrective actions.
* Drive common KPIs and improvement targets for supplier PPM, repeat defects, corrective-action aging, disruptions.
* Require leadership reviews and improvement plans for systemic issues, sharing lessons learned across suppliers.
* Supplier Scorecard (VS051 rating) and drive continuous improvement for supplier quality performance.

**Supplier APQP / PPAP & Safe Launch**

* Ensure on time and effective supplier APQP, PPAP, and Safe Launch for new programs, suppliers, and changes, including risk reviews, capability verification, and readiness-gap closure before production release.

**Quality Tools, Talent Development & Training**

* Set expectations for consistent SQE application of core quality tools, process audits, and structured problem solving to strengthen prevention and corrective-action effectiveness.
* Assess global SQ team capabilities and set development priorities with regional managers to strengthen technical expertise, expand skills, and build future leaders through training, mentoring, and succession planning.
* Supplier Quality talent review and succession plan.

**Regional Leadership: Engineering Quality & Operational Quality** (20% of role)

* Represent Quality Leadership team in regional activities across RDE, Manufacturing and Supplier Quality teams.
* Align regional priorities, governance, performance reviews, and escalations with global Engineering Quality and Operational Quality leaders and standards.
* Guide development and launch readiness, qual

**About Tufts Medicine**

Tufts Medicine brings together the best of academic and community medicine to deliver exceptional, connected and accessible care. Comprised of Tufts Medical Center, the principal teaching hospital of Tufts University and the Tufts University School of Medicine, Lowell General Hospital, MelroseWakefield Hospital, Lawrence Memorial Hospital of Medford, Care at Home, and an integrated network of 2,300 physicians, we treat the most complex conditions, keep our communities healthy and bring research breakthroughs to life.

**Job Overview**

This position reports to the Vice President of the Cardiovascular Service Line and serves as a key leader at Tufts Medicine. The role provides operational and strategic oversight across multiple community cardiology clinics in the Boston metro area.

Operating within a collaborative leadership model and with a focus on service excellence in the ambulatory environment, this position is accountable for:

* Ensuring high-quality patient access and experience
* Driving financial performance and profitability
* Optimizing all revenue cycle processes
* Advancing strategic initiatives across the cardiology service line

This role plays a critical part in shaping the cardiovascular ambulatory strategy, enhancing operational effectiveness, and supporting the delivery of exceptional care across all cardiology sites.

* Framingham (Heart Center Metro West)
* Melrose
* Merrimack Valley
* Norwood

2. Seven (7) years of healthcare management or practice management experience working directly with physicians and practice members.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

2. Ten (10) years of healthcare management or practice management experience working directly with physicians and practice members.

3. Experience in Cardiovascular Service Line.

Karman Space & Defense is a leader in the rapid design, development, and production of critical, next-generation system solutions that align with the U.S. Department of War and its allies' core mission priorities, and meet the accelerating demand for access to space. Building on nearly 50 years of success, we deliver Payload & Protection Systems, Aero/Hydrodynamic Interstage Systems, and Propulsion & Launch Systems to more than 80 prime contractors supporting over 130 space and defense programs.

This role is part of our Space and Launch business, which has contributed to the nation's space programs for decades by delivering complete solutions from concept to flight. We enable successful space operations with mission-critical technology supporting every step from first launch to final landing, including launch vehicle subsystems, propulsion systems, aerodynamic and interstage systems, and payload protection and deployment. Our high-performance solutions are engineered to operate in the most extreme environments and meet precise mission requirements.

Lead manufacturing operations across Karman's El Monte and Corona locations, aligning machining, fabrication, and downstream processing with business objectives. In this role, you will drive safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, and profitability by providing operational leadership, strengthening cross-functional collaboration, and advancing continuous improvement initiatives across complex manufacturing environments.

**Responsibilities**

* Leads and coordinates manufacturing operations across the El Monte and Corona locations, establishing accountability, performance expectations, and operating rhythms for operations managers and functional departments.
* Develops and executes operational plans that align production performance, capacity, and investment priorities with company strategy.
* Oversees machining, fabrication, forming, finishing, and assembly operations to improve throughput, schedule attainment, labor productivity, and profitability.
* Drives operational excellence by implementing procedures and standards that improve safety, quality, delivery, cost, and regulatory compliance.
* Champions Lean manufacturing and continuous improvement through 5S, Kaizen, flow and lead-time improvements, cycle-time and setup reduction, Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), and preventative maintenance.
* Analyzes financial and production data, including overall equipment effectiveness (OEE), spindle utilization, and labor efficiency, to manage budgets, inventory, spending, and cost performance.
* Ensures equipment readiness, maintenance execution, and manufacturing capacity align with production requirements.
* Partners with human resources on workforce planning, recruiting, organizational structure, labor utilization, work scheduling, leadership development, performance evaluation, and succession planning.
* Coordinates closed-loop communication and escalation across operations, engineering, quality, supply chain, and program management.
* Manages the administration and performance of subcontracted and temporary labor services.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, operations management, manufacturing, or a related technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience that includes a minimum of 10 years of relevant manufacturing leadership experience.
* At least 10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including oversight of complex production environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master of Business Administration (MBA), Master of Science (MS), or another advanced degree.
* Operational leadership experience in precision manufacturing supporting aerospace or defense production.
* Leadership experience in a computer numerical control (CNC) machining environment producing large, tight-tolerance metallic components.
* Experience machining aluminum using 3-axis and 5-axis milling and large gantry equi

Futures start here. Where first steps, new friendships, and confident learners are born. At KinderCare Learning Companies, the first and only early childhood education provider recognized with the**Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award**, we offer a variety of early education and child care options for families. Whether it’s KinderCare Learning Centers, Champions, or Crème de la Crème, we build confidence for kids, families, and the future we share. And we want you to join us in shaping it—in neighborhoods, at work, and in schools nationwide.

At Crème de la Crème, learning comes alive like nowhere else. Our centers are places that never stand still because kids never do. And when you join us, you’ll become part of that magic—making a memorable impact on young learners and their families every day. In our wow-worthy world of learning, your talents will be the catalyst for creating child care experiences you've never imagined. You’ll link arms with other exceptional humans who care as much about helping kids reach their highest potential as you do—and you’ll know that your work matters.

* As the Crème School Director of Education and Quality, you will 
 + Lead and develop teachers to ensure curriculum alignment with best practices, state standards, and the individual needs of children.
 + Facilitate training and implementation of our comprehensive and developmentally appropriate curriculum for early childhood education.
 + Provide transformative leadership in the field of early childhood education, staying informed about current trends, research, and best practices.
 + Develop a culture of continuous learning and professional development while leading the teaching staff.
 + Establish and maintain high-quality standards for early childhood education program
 + Conduct regular assessments, evaluations, and audits to ensure compliance with Crème standards and licensing requirements
 + Provide guidance and support to teaching staff, promoting a positive and collaborative work environment. In partnership with the Executive Director, host professional development programs to enhance educators' skills and knowledge.
 + Cultivate positive relationships with teachers and parents, involving them in their child's education and development.
 + Collaborate with the community to enhance the educational experience and promote your school within the community.
 + Assist as needed in daily school operations, at times including direct supervision of children
 + Apply data-driven insights to assess program effectiveness, implement strategies to address identified areas of improvement, fostering a culture of continuous quality enhancement.
* Qualifications:
* + Bachelor’s degree in early childhood education, Education Administration, or a related field. (preferred)
 + Meet state specific credentials / guidelines for the role
 + At least one year leadership experience in early childhood education or a related field
 + Proven understanding of early childhood development, educational best practices, and program administration.
 + Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
 + Outstanding customer service skills, strong organizational skills, and multi-task and handle multiple situations optimally.
 + Proven ability to build and sustain positive relationships with diverse staff, families, and community. Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in education.
 + Physically able to use a computer with basic proficiency, lift a minimum of 40pounds, and work indoors or outdoors.
 + Able to assume postures in low levels to allow physical and visual contact with children, see and hear well enough to keep children safe, and engage in physical activity.
 + Read, write, understand, and speak English to connect with children and their parents in English.

Range of pay $34,216.00 - $62,100.00 Salary

**Our benefits meet you where you are.** We’re here to help our employees navigate the integration of work and life: 

* Know your whole family is supported

record.ROLE_TEXT:
Job Summary
 
The Director, Food Safety & Quality is a senior, project-based individual contributor who is deployed to the most critical food safety and quality priorities across Maker’s Pride’s manufacturing network. Rather than leading a team, this leader goes where the need is greatest: stepping into facilities, programs, and issues that require immediate expertise, rapidly assessing the situation, and leading cross-functional teams to resolution without direct authority. Working in close partnership with plant leadership, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Product Development, Sanitation, and plant FSQA teams, the Director stabilizes high-risk areas, solves complex problems, and builds sustainable capability so improvements hold after the engagement ends. This role serves as a senior technical decision-maker on food safety risk and represents the company with regulators, key customers, and certification bodies on escalated matters.
 
 
Key Responsibilities
 
Critical Site & Program Interventions
 

* Deploy to facilities, lines, and programs identified as highest risk or underperforming, often on short notice, to assess conditions and lead immediate stabilization.
* Rapidly diagnose root causes of food safety and quality gaps and develop clear, prioritized action plans with plant leadership.
* Lead cross-functional plant teams through execution of improvement plans, removing barriers and escalating risks as needed.
* Transition sustainable processes, tools, and ownership to site leadership before exiting each engagement.

Project Leadership & Prioritization
 

* Lead a portfolio of high-impact food safety and quality projects, defining scope, objectives, milestones, and success measures for each.
* Partner with the VP of HSE, FSQA to prioritize engagements based on enterprise risk, business impact, and customer or regulatory exposure.
* Manage multiple concurrent projects across sites, adjusting priorities quickly as new critical issues emerge.
* Provide regular project status, risk updates, and outcomes to the VP of HSE, FSQA and executive leadership.

Food Safety Risk Management & Decision-Making
 

* Serve as a senior technical decision-maker on food safety risk, including product hold, release, and disposition decisions.
* Lead or support the company’s response to food safety incidents, including recall and market withdrawal events, in partnership with senior leadership.

The Leonardo DRS Naval Electronics business provides leading naval computing infrastructure, network and data distribution and middleware enterprise services, as well as world-class manufacturing and support capabilities.

**Business Unit**: Naval Electronics
 
**Location**: Eagan, MN
 
**Career Functional Area**: Engineering
 
**Telework Type**: Hybrid
 
**Travel Expectation**: 30%
 
**Schedule**: 9/80

**Job Summary**
---------------

Responsible for establishing and continuously improving the processes, tools, and data-management practices that enable disciplined, compliant, and efficient engineering execution across all programs. Own engineering configuration-management standards, processes and execution releasing the E BOM. Monitor the quality of engineering deliverables identifying opportunities of improvement.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Engineering Process Ownership and Excellence**

* Define, deploy, maintain, and continuously improve standardized engineering processes, procedures, work instructions, templates
* Ensure engineering processes are practical for program execution while meeting applicable customer, contractual, quality, regulatory, cybersecurity, and internal requirements.
* Establish process ownership, approval authorities, compliance expectations, training requirements, and periodic process-review cycles.
* Lead process maturity assessments, identify gaps and inefficiencies, and implement corrective and preventive improvements.

**Engineering Tools and Digital Strategy**

* Define the engineering tools strategy, roadmap, governance model, and deployment plans in partnership with Engineering, IT, Quality, Supply Chain, and program teams.
* Lead deployment, adoption, administration requirements, user support models, and continuous improvement of engineering tools, including product lifecycle management, requirements management, analysis, collaboration, and configuration-management tools.
* Ensure tools, workflows, data structures, and integrations support disciplined engineering execution, traceability, release control, and reliable engineering data.
* Capture user and program needs; prioritize enhancements, integrations, and new capabilities based on business value, risk reduction, compliance, and program demand.

**Engineering Configuration Management**

* Own the engineering configuration-management process, standards, governance, and associated tool workflows.
* Establish common rules for engineering baselines, configuration identification, revision control, change management, release authorization, and configuration-status accounting.
* Ensure configuration-management processes support full traceability between requirements, drawings, parts, assemblies, bills of material, changes, verification evidence, and released product definition.
* Define the governance framework for configuration control boards and ensure appropriate technical, quality, programmatic, manufacturing, supply-chain, and customer inputs are incorporated where required.

**Job Responsibilities (Cont.)**
--------------------------------

**Program Configuration-Management Support**

* Provide configuration-management process leadership and tailored support to programs from proposal through product support.
* Support development, review, and maintenance of program Configuration Management Plans and related configuration-management deliverables.
* Establish program-specific configuration baselines, release schedules, change-control workflows, approval matrices, and reporting appropriate to contractual and product requirements.
* Support programs in resolving configuration-management issues, ensuring timely decisions and minimizing release, production, and customer-impact risk.

**Product-Definition Data Integrity**

* Govern the processes for drawing-number creation, part-number assignment, nomenclature, document classification, and engineering-data release.
* Ensure new drawing and part

Director-Quality Management - Acute | Highland Hospital | Charleston, West Virginia

**About the Job:**

PURPOSE STATEMENT: 
 
The Director of Quality, Risk & Compliance leads and coordinates quality and performance improvement, regulatory compliance, and patient safety efforts within the healthcare facility. This role ensures that all programs operate within local, state, federal, and accreditation standards, while driving a culture of continuous improvement, clinical excellence, and risk reduction.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Provides oversight of all facility programs, including inpatient and outpatient services, ensuring alignment with quality, risk management, patient safety, and regulatory standards.
* Leads facility-wide quality, risk, and patient safety strategy and improvement efforts.
* Directs the Quality Assurance/Performance Improvement (QAPI) program, including development, implementation, and evaluation; monitors KPIs and ensures governance of data-driven improvement efforts.
* Drives organization-wide performance improvement initiatives through data analysis and system-level process enhancements to improve outcomes.
* Oversees incident reporting, investigations, and risk analyses (RCA/Event Analysis), ensuring timely resolution and prevention of recurrence.
* Maintains compliance with all local, state, federal (CMS), and accreditation standards (TJC), ensures ongoing survey readiness, and serves as the primary liaison during regulatory and accreditation surveys, audits, and required reporting activities.
* Partners with the Legal, Compliance, and Risk Department on high-risk events, complaints/allegations, investigations, and corrective action planning.
* Supports the development, review, and implementation of facility policies and procedures, ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and consistent adherence across departments.
* Collaborates with department leaders and Human Resources to support staff accountability and ensure adherence to facility policies and procedures.
* Provides staff training and mentoring to support competency, accountability, and adherence to quality, risk, and safety standards, while fostering a culture of continuous improvement and patient safety.
* Conducts leadership rounding, medical record reviews, and monitoring of environment of care, safety, and documentation standards.
* Prepares and maintains required reports and documentation; participates in committees, meetings, audits, and organizational initiatives.
* Supervises Patient Advocate/Coordinator roles, when applicable, through hiring, orienting, performance assessment and management, motivating, training, scheduling, and coaching to meet department and facility goals. Supports resolution of patient concerns and patient rights processes.
* Serves as Patient Safety and Compliance Officer, providing oversight of patient safety, risk management, and event reporting processes within organizational governance structures.
* Serves as Patient Safety and Compliance Officer, providing oversight of client safety, risk management, and event reporting processes within organizational governance structures.
* May serve as Privacy/Security Officer, providing direction and oversight of activities related to compliance with applicable Federal and State law and regulations governing the privacy and security of health information.
* May serve as Chief Healthcare Disparities Officer, leading efforts to identify, analyze, and reduce disparities in care for the populations served.
* May be required to provide onsite coverage for other programs when needed, develops, and executes new programs according to market needs and may provide training, case consultation and Administrator On Call coverage during and after program hours as needed.

**EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE/SKILL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor’s degree with a clinical, nursing or business emphasis required. Master’s degree in Human Services preferred.

Description:

With over 30 yrs. in the Landscape Rock and Construction Materials Supplier industry, **MDI ROCK** continues to be the largest family owned Landscape Supply Company in Arizona. With locations in Phoenix, Prescott, Queen Creek, Dewey, and Ash Fork.

**MDI ROCK** is currently seeking a **PLANT MANAGER** for our Dewey Rock Quarry located in **DEWEY, AZ**.

The Plant Manager will oversee all daily operations of the plant from production and manufacturing to ensuring employees meet company standards for Safety, Quality, and efficiency.

**Responsibilities**

* Plan, organize, direct and run optimum day-to-day operations to exceed our customers’ expectations
* Increase production, assets capacity and flexibility while minimizing unnecessary costs and maintaining current quality standards
* Be responsible for production output, product quality and on-time shipping
* Allocate resources effectively and fully utilize assets to produce optimal results
* Implement strategies in alignment with strategic initiatives and provide a clear sense of direction and focus
* Monitor operations and trigger corrective actions
* Share a trusting relationship with workgroup and recruit, manage and develop plant staff
* Develop systems and processes that track and optimize productivity and standards, metrics and performance targets to ensure effective return on assets
* Operate loaders, rock trucks, excavators, and drilling equipment

Requirements:

**Skills**

* Proven work experience as a plant manager
* Working knowledge and understanding of MSHA regulations and possess a strong personal commitment to safety believing all incidents are preventable
* Understanding of aggregate processing and equipment
* Excellent verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills and capable of developing and maintaining good relationships with company and regulatory agency personnel
* Knowledge of ATF and ADEQ laws and requirements
* Ability to create accountability and to lead by example
* Strong team building, decision-making and people management skills

**Perks:**

* Medical, Dental, and Vision after 90 days
* 401k with Employer Match after 90 days
* PTO/PST

**MDI ROCK supports the Drug Free Workplace Act and therefore requires pre-employment drug screening on all newly hired employees. All offers of employment are contingent upon the receipt of satisfactory drug screening results**.

**MDI ROCK** participates in E-Verify.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: From $70,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience/certification with MSHA?

Do you have experience/certification with the ATF?

Experience:

* Management: 5 years (Preferred)
* Aggregate Plant: 3 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

**Job Description Summary:**

At The Coca-Cola Company, we bring together the power of our people, our brands, technology and innovation to refresh the world and make a difference. Our manufacturing operations are critical to delivering quality products safely, efficiently and reliably, and automation plays an increasingly important role in how we build the manufacturing environment of the future.

 

The **Senior Manager, Automation and Controls** will be based at our Ontario, California facility and will lead automation and controls capabilities that support safe, reliable and efficient manufacturing operations. This role will have primary responsibility for the Ontario facility while providing limited automation and controls support to our Portland facility, requiring approximately 5% travel.

This position will lead a small team of Automation and Controls Technicians and serve as a senior technical resource for automation, controls, instrumentation and manufacturing systems. The role will partner closely with Engineering, Maintenance, Operations, Quality, Safety and Information Technology teams to improve equipment reliability, strengthen controls infrastructure, support capital projects and advance manufacturing technology.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in industrial automation and controls with practical manufacturing experience, strong problem-solving capabilities and effective people leadership. They bring a continuous-improvement mindset and can translate operational challenges into sustainable automation solutions while developing the technical capabilities of their team.

 

**Key Responsibilities and Position-Related Functions**
-------------------------------------------------------

* Lead and develop a small team of Automation and Controls Technicians, establishing clear priorities, technical standards, development plans and expectations for safe and effective execution.
* Provide technical leadership for the Ontario manufacturing facility across industrial automation, programmable logic controllers (Rockwell PLC Platform), human-machine interfaces, supervisory control systems, instrumentation, industrial networks, motion control and related manufacturing technologies.
* Ignition Software Platform and Database Development experience.
* Provide limited automation and controls support for the Portland facility, including technical troubleshooting, project consultation and alignment on controls standards, with approximately 5% travel.
* Partner with Operations, Maintenance and Engineering teams to identify chronic equipment issues, determine root causes and implement controls and automation solutions that improve reliability, throughput and operating performance.
* Lead troubleshooting of complex controls and automation issues, using structured problem-solving, equipment data and technical expertise to reduce downtime and prevent recurrence.
* Establish and maintain controls standards, system documentation, software backups, change-management practices and lifecycle strategies for automation assets.
* Support capital projects from concept through commissioning by developing technical requirements, evaluating automation solutions, reviewing control system designs and ensuring successful installation, testing, start-up and handover.
* Partner with internal teams, original equipment manufacturers, system integrators and other technical suppliers to ensure automation solutions meet operational requirements and established Coca-Cola standards.
* Develop strategies for managing aging or obsolete controls hardware and software, prioritizing replacements based on operational risk, equipment criticality and business needs.
* Strengthen preventive and predictive maintenance practices for automation and controls systems to improve equipment availability and reduce unplanned failures.
* Use manufacturing and controls data to identify performance trends, recurring losses and improvement opportunities, t

The Operations Director is responsible for the oversight of all phases of warehouse operations, including setup, production, quality control, maintenance, receiving, picking, and shipping. In addition, the Operations Director works closely with the operations team to increase productivity and profitability within the operation. Responsibilities include staffing, P&L management, vendor relations, and process improvement. The Operations Director also interacts closely with Account/Service Delivery teams and client contacts.

**YOUR TASKS**

* Manage multiple P&Ls in a cost center environment
* Direct activities associated with daily operations and client requirements
* Lead the development and implementation of operating processes
* Lead and direct fulfillment and distribution operations
* Develop, implement, and manage highly customized workflows in a supply chain management environment from receipt of data through value-added services/packaging to outbound
* Hire, train, and evaluate supervisory and management staff
* Initiate and coordinate large projects (e.g., equipment justification and procurement, facility layout)
* Stay current on information technology affecting functional areas to increase productivity and/or decrease costs

,

Carbel, now part of Arvato, is a fast-growing third-party logistics (3PL) provider specializing in e-commerce and retail distribution. We support globally recognized retail and consumer brands through a rapidly expanding U.S. network of distribution centers, combining operational agility with scalable logistics solutions.

Arvato is an innovative and leading global 3PL service provider in supply chain management and e-commerce. With 20,000 team members at over 100 locations, we focus on the Consumer Products, Tech, Healthcare, Automotive and Publisher industries.

You will work in an environment built on collaboration, respect, commitment and curiosity, where you can grow, contribute your ideas, and make an impact. Be part of the team that delivers logistics excellence and shapes supply chains globally. Working at Arvato means: Together, we’re on it.

,

* Paid Time Off, including paid holidays.
* Voluntary benefits such as Dental, Vision, and Gap insurance, short-term disability, paid family leave, accident insurance, critical illness and cancer insurance.
 

**Disclosure requirements pertaining to the collection of your personal data:**

Responsible for processing the information provided in your application is the company specified in the job advertisement, with its registered office as indicated. The company processes your data for the purpose of establishing an employment relationship on the basis of Art. 6 (1) b GDPR / Section 26 (1) sentence 1 BDSG.

The retention period for your data is determined by the statutory time limits applicable in the respective country, beginning upon completion of the recruitment process. You can find these here .

You can contact the company’s Data Protection Officer at the above-mentioned postal address.

 

We strive to be an equitable and inclusive workplace for our employees and value their diverse perspectives, which contribute to the diversity of our company. Therefore, we welcome applications from people who enrich our company with their identity, background and personal experience. We want to keep the application process as simple as possible for you: focus on a meaningful resume; we do not require an elaborate cover letter. Please know that we can only accept your application through our online application portal.

Learn more about our commitment to Equal Opportunity and Accommodation Information here .

record.ROLE_TEXT:
**Onco360 is continuing to grow, and we're seeking new team members. Join a mission-driven team making a difference in the lives of cancer patients.**

Our Onco360 Pharmacy has a need for a Director of Pharmacy Operations!

**Starting Pay:** **$160k and up, depending on experience** 
**Employment:** Full-Time

**Current Available Schedule:**

**Monday - Friday - 8am - 4:30pm EST**

**Onco360 Pharmacy is a unique oncology pharmacy model created to serve the needs of community, oncology and hematology physicians, patients, payers, and manufacturers.**

**We offer a variety of benefits** including: Medical; Dental; Vision; 401k opportunity; Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays; Tuition Reimbursement; Company paid benefits – life insurance; and short and long-term disability

A career with us is more than just a job. It's an opportunity to connect and care for our patients, providers, communities and each other. We attract extraordinary people who have a strong desire to live our mission - to better the lives of those battling cancer and rare diseases. Compassion is more important than numbers. We value teamwork, respect, integrity, and passion.

We succeed when you do, and our company and management team work hard to foster an environment that provides you with opportunities for both professional and personal growth.

***The Director of Pharmacy Operations will be responsible for the operation, direction, coordination, evaluation and management of the Pharmacy Operation. In addition, the Director of Pharmacy Operations will be responsible for the organization and implementation of policies and procedures that are established. The Director of Pharmacy Operations will participate in and oversee the pharmaceutical services to oncology patients in a manner that maximizes quality and patient safety.***

Director of Pharmacy Operations Major Responsibilities:

* Working in collaboration with Senior Director of Pharmacy Operations, the Director of Pharmacy Operations will determine the day-to-day priorities for the pharmacy staff and adjust those priorities as need be to meet the high touch needs of the pharmacy’s patients.
* The Director of Pharmacy Operations will ensure that prescription orders process through daily workflow in a timely manner
* Assists Senior Director in monitoring day-to-day pharmacy operations and driving workflow to ensure that the accurate and timely dispensing of quality pharmacy services is consistently delivered to all customers/residents using effective service leadership and customer skills.
* Develops creative solutions to workflow and process challenges and works with Senior Director and Operations Staff to implement changes or enhancements to process.
* Oversee workflow and coordinate with managers/supervisors/vertical leads on productivity and staff allocation to ensure timely prescription processing and accountability of performance
* Manages staff in a leadership role to maintain a positive working environment by creating synergy and teamwork to minimize employee relations issues and reduce turnover. Communicates effectively with coworkers and customers, and successfully resolves issues.
* Works with pharmacy management to control operating expenses by effective utilization of personnel, equipment and supplies to maintain and improve services within approved budget.
* Plan, organize and ensure adherence to Onco360 pharmacy policies and procedures.
* Interview, select and supervise the activities of the pharmacy staff; communicate interpret and discuss with staff policies and procedures.
* Determine job objectives, work methods and performance standards; review performance relative to departmental objectives; authorize and communicate salary changes, promotions, transfers, discipline and discharge and administer all other personnel actions when necessary to maintain consistent and productive workflow in the pharmacy.
* Appropriately recognize organizational lines within the department; keep employees inform
